raw.description:
BSN SPORTS, A VARSITY BRANDS COMPANY - THE RECOGNIZED LEADER IN TEAM ATHLETIC GEAR

For over 50 years, BSN SPORTS has been the largest team sporting goods equipment and apparel distributor of choice in the United States. Our 3,000 BSN SPORTS employees strive to support the Heart of the Game by putting valuable time back into the day of coaches and administrators through excellent service platforms. Our company mission is simple: Save coaches and administrators time with everything they do off the field so they have more time to impact young lives on it.

WORK TYPE: Full-Time Remote in Dallas

LOCATION: DFW

HOURS: Monday-Friday 8 AM to 5 PM CT

HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT

At BSN SPORTS, we believe sports have the power to change lives. Behind every athlete is a coach, teacher, administrator, and support team making those moments possible. Our mission is simple: save our customers time so they can spend more of it changing lives.

As part of the Learning & Development team, you'll help build the knowledge, skills, and confidence of employees across the organization—creating learning experiences that improve performance, strengthen partnerships, and support business growth.

The Training Manager is responsible for managing enterprise learning initiatives that support Inside Sales and Sales Support. This role serves as the primary project manager for learning requests, partnering with business leaders to assess needs, prioritize work, oversee curriculum development, and ensure high-quality learning solutions are delivered on time.

Working closely with the Director of Leadership Development & Sales Enablement, Digital Learning, and business stakeholders, the Training Manager designs, develops, and delivers engaging learning experiences, including onboarding, systems training, skill development, and reinforcement programs. This role facilitates both in-person and virtual instructor-led training sessions, ensuring learners are equipped with the knowledge, skills, and confidence to perform successfully.

The Training Manager drives consistency, quality, and continuous improvement across all learning programs while maintaining enterprise standards for instructional design and learner experience.

This position is an individual contributor and does not have direct reports.

WHAT YOU’LL DO ON A DAILY BASIS

Learning Strategy & Project Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for enterprise learning requests across supported business functions.
  • Partner with leaders to identify learning needs, define project scope, establish priorities, and manage timelines.
  • Coordinate multiple learning projects simultaneously while ensuring alignment with business objectives.
  • Monitor project progress and communicate status, risks, and milestones to stakeholders.

Curriculum Development & Learning Programs

  • Design, develop, and maintain instructor-led, virtual, self-paced, and blended learning solutions.
  • Build onboarding, role-based, systems, process, product, and professional development programs.
  • Create reinforcement learning, micro-learning, and performance support resources.
  • Ensure learning content remains current, relevant, and aligned with business processes.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Collaborate with leaders across Sales, Customer Care, Financial Services, Sales Support, and other enterprise functions.
  • Consult with business partners to recommend learning solutions that improve performance.
  • Build trusted relationships while managing stakeholder expectations regarding scope, priorities, and delivery timelines.

Learning Standards & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain enterprise standards for instructional design, learner experience, branding, and content quality.
  • Evaluate training effectiveness using learner feedback, business metrics, and performance data.
  • Recommend process improvements that increase learning efficiency, scalability, and business impact.
  • Ensure learning assets align with digital learning standards and AI-supported development practices.

QUALIFICATIONS:

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES

  • Experience supporting Sales, Customer Care, Financial Services, Operations, or other enterprise business functions.
  • Experience designing and delivering onboarding programs, role-based training, and ongoing skill development initiatives.
  • Strong facilitation skills with experience leading engaging instructor-led, virtual, and hybrid learning experiences for diverse audiences.
  • Experience developing digital learning, micro-learning, and blended learning solutions.
  • Knowledge of adult learning principles, instructional design methodologies, and learner engagement best practices.
  • Experience using AI-enabled content development tools, learning technologies, and learning management systems.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Learning & Development, Education, Organizational Development, Business, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience designing, developing, and managing corporate learning programs.
  • Experience managing multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Strong instructional design and curriculum development skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office and learning management systems.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job.

JOIN THE BEST TEAM IN SPORT & SPIRIT

At Varsity Brands, we believe every student deserves the opportunity to succeed and every educator wants to make a difference. It takes a team to make a real impact, and through our two divisions – BSN SPORTS and Varsity Spirit – and our network of 6,000+ employees and independent representatives, we are proud to partner with a wide range of educational institutions and club and professional sports to transform the student journey in SPORT and SPIRIT.

OUR VALUES

Service - We lead with heart. We champion community.

Passion - We love what we do. It fuels our purpose.

Integrity - We do what we promise. We own our actions and decisions.

Respect - We earn it by giving it. Because everyone deserves it.

Innovation - We never stop striving to be better. For ourselves and our community.

Transparency - We are committed to openness and honesty in everything we do.

OUR BENEFITS

We are committed to putting you and your families first. For benefits eligible roles, we offer a variety of choices and costs as well as program enhancements that align with our responsibility to elevate the employee experience. Some of our offerings include:

  • Comprehensive Health Care Benefits
  • HSA Employer Contribution/ FSA Opportunities
  • Wellbeing Program
  • 401(k) plan with company matching
  • Company paid Life, AD&D, and Short-Term Disability
  • Generous My Time Off & Paid Holidays
  • Varsity Brands Ownership Program
  • Employee Resource Groups
  • Access to Financial Coaching and member-owned Credit Union
  • St. Jude Partnership & Volunteer Opportunities
  • Employee Perks including discounts on personal apparel and equipment!

Varsity Brands companies are equal opportunity employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran’s status, age or disability.

Overview

Join an amazing team that is consistently recognized for our achievements and culture, including our most recent Forbes award of being one of America's Best Midsize Employers for 2026!

Position Summary:

We are seeking an Director of Engineering, AI/ML, where you'll lead the development and scaling of advanced AI models and capabilities that automates internal operation as well as provides personalized experience for our customers and agents. This role is essential in building and managing a world-class team of ML Engineers and Data/ML Scientists. Your expertise will guide teams in building reliable systems that deliver impactful solutions. This role will be pivotal in developing and deploying innovative AI solutions at scale, address insurtech challenges.

You will drive the company’s mission forward by optimizing policy/coverage recommendations, providing personalized experience with data, and driving automation to reduce human effort across Underwriting, Claim, Customer Support etc. using AI/ML. You will oversee the entire machine learning lifecycle, from concept to deployment, with strategic focus on delivering impactful, data-driven solutions. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Machine Learning algorithms, Deep Learning, NLP, LLMs, and Generative AI technologies, with a strong background in insurTech related AI applications. If you are passionate about driving change through AI in the insurTech, this is an exceptional opportunity.

Geo-Salary Information

An in-person interview may be required during the hiring process

State specific pay scales for this role are as follows:

$137,883 to $386,920 (CA, NJ, NY, WA, HI, AK, MD, CT, RI, MA)

$137,883 to $386,920 (NV, OR, AZ, CO, WY, TX, ND, MN, MO, IL, WI, FL, GA, MI, OH, VA, PA, DE, VT, NH, ME)

$137,883 to $386,920 (UT, ID, MT, NM, SD, NE, KS, OK, IA, AR, LA, MS, AL, TN, KY, IN, SC, NC, WV)

The expected base salary for this position will vary depending on a number of factors, including relevant experience, skills and location.

In CA: Typical hiring range is $236,161 to $328,002

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Lead and manage the machine learning team to build state-of-the-art AI models, focusing on user experience personalization, recommendations and operation automation.
  • Design and implement ML solutions to personalize customer and agent experience across the insurance lifecycle (quote, bind, service, claim, etc.).
  • Implements AI solutions to optimize processes and reduce operational costs.
  • Lead GenAI effort for both operation automation and customer experience improvement.
  • Collaborate with leadership, product, and technical teams to align ML strategy with business goals.
  • Maintain cutting-edge knowledge of advancements in AI, include in Machine learning algorithms, Deep Learning, Generative AI, NLP, and LLMs, and apply them to drive innovation within the organization.
  • Provide leadership and mentorship to junior team members, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence.

Qualifications

Education:

  • Minimum:
    • B.S. Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematical or related
  • Preferred:
    • B.S./M.S./PHD Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematical or related

Experience:

  • Minimum:
    • 8+ years of experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, LLMs, and Generative AI.
    • 5+ years of experience in application developments.
    • 5+ years management experience
  • Preferred:
    • 10+ years of experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, LLMs, and Generative AI.
    • 5+ years experience in building large scale enterprise application and platform.
    • 8+ years leadership experience
    • 3+ experience on insurTech

Skills & Abilities

  • Minimum:
    • 10+ years of experience in Machine Learning algorithms, Deep Learning, NLP, LLMs, and Generative AI.
    • Strong background in applied research and engineering, with a demonstrated ability to lead projects from R&D to deployment.
    • Knowledge in large-scale system deployment of AI models.
    • Expertise in building and optimizing POCs, with hands-on experience in training and fine-tuning AI models.
    • Advanced proficiency in Java, Python, ML frameworks and ml libraries.
    • Great communication and leadership skills, with the ability to present complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Preferred:
    • Proven experience in insurTech or related industries is strongly preferred.
    • Experience on public cloud such as aws, sagemaker, MLflow, etc. is preferred.

About the Company

Why choose a career at Mercury?

At Mercury, we have been guided by our purpose to help people reduce risk and overcome unexpected events for more than 60 years. We are one team with a common goal to help others. Everyone needs insurance and we can’t imagine a world without it.

Our team will encourage you to grow, make time to have fun, and work together to make great things happen. We embrace the strengths and values of each team member. We believe in having diverse perspectives where everyone is included, to serve customers from all walks of life.

We care about our people, and we mean it. We reward our talented professionals with a competitive salary, bonus potential, and a variety of benefits to help our team members reach their health, retirement, and professional goals.

Learn more about us here:

Perks and Benefits

We offer many great benefits, including:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexibility to work from anywhere in the United States for most positions
  • Paid time off (vacation time, sick time, 9 paid Company holidays, volunteer hours)
  • Incentive bonus programs (potential for holiday bonus, referral bonus, and performance-based bonus)
  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and pet insurance
  • 401 (k) retirement savings plan with company match
  • Engaging work environment
  • Promotional opportunities
  • Education assistance
  • Professional and personal development opportunities
  • Company recognition program
  • Health and wellbeing resources, including free mental wellbeing therapy/coaching sessions, child and eldercare resources, and more

Mercury Insurance is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

Pay Range

USD $133,226.00 - USD $346,026.00 /Yr.

Entry-Level Remote Customer Service Representative | Benefits & Client Support

Company: AO | Globe Life
Work Arrangement: 100% Remote | U.S. Residents Only
Schedule: Full-Time | Flexible Schedule
Experience: Entry Level | No Insurance Experience Required
Compensation: Commission-Based | Weekly Pay | Performance Incentives
Training: Comprehensive Training, Licensing Guidance & Mentorship Provided

Empower Families. Develop Your Skills. Build Your Career — All From Home.

Are you looking for an entry-level work-from-home career where you can use your people skills, help families, and create opportunities for professional and financial growth?

AO | Globe Life is seeking motivated, service-oriented professionals to join our growing virtual team as Remote Customer Service Representatives / Benefits Advisors.

You'll work directly with individuals and families through scheduled virtual appointments, answer questions, explain available benefit options, assist with enrollment, and provide ongoing client support.

This role combines customer service, member support, relationship building, benefits education, and consultative insurance sales.

No previous insurance experience is required.

We provide structured training, licensing guidance, mentorship, and ongoing professional development to help motivated individuals learn the business and build confidence.

✓ 100% Remote / Work From Home
✓ Entry Level – No Insurance Experience Required
✓ Qualified Client Opportunities Provided
✓ No Traditional Cold Calling
✓ No Lead Purchasing Required
✓ Weekly Commission-Based Pay
✓ Performance Bonuses & Incentives
✓ Renewal & Residual Income Opportunities
✓ Training & One-on-One Mentorship
✓ Leadership & Career Advancement Opportunities

Who We Are

AO operates within the American Income Division of Globe Life and has a long history of serving working families, including members of labor unions, associations, veterans, and their families.

Our representatives help clients better understand supplemental life, accident, and health insurance options while providing professional service before, during, and after enrollment.

Our virtual business model allows representatives to build their careers from home while remaining connected through modern technology, structured training, mentorship, coaching, and team collaboration.

Our culture emphasizes service, integrity, accountability, professional development, and performance-based growth.

What You'll Do

As a Remote Customer Service Representative / Benefits Advisor, you'll serve as a trusted resource for prospective and existing clients.

🤝 Customer Service & Member Support

  • Meet with clients through scheduled Zoom and phone appointments

  • Connect with individuals and families interested in learning more about available benefits

  • Ask questions to understand each client's needs and priorities

  • Answer questions clearly, professionally, and accurately

  • Provide personalized service throughout the client experience

  • Maintain consistent communication and follow-up

  • Build long-term relationships based on trust and professionalism

  • Maintain accurate digital client records and documentation

🛡️ Benefits Education & Enrollment

Once appropriately licensed, you'll:

  • Explain available life, accident, and supplemental health insurance options

  • Help clients understand coverage features and benefit choices

  • Conduct needs-focused benefit reviews

  • Provide personalized recommendations based on client needs

  • Guide eligible clients through applications and enrollment

  • Assist with required documentation and beneficiary information

  • Help clients understand the coverage they select

❤️ Ongoing Client Service

Your relationship with clients continues after enrollment.

Responsibilities may include:

  • Conducting applicable policy and benefit reviews

  • Assisting with beneficiary updates

  • Answering policy-related questions

  • Providing ongoing client support

  • Helping clients navigate appropriate service and claims resources

  • Maintaining accurate follow-up records

  • Building long-term client relationships

📞 Qualified Client Opportunities – No Traditional Cold Calling

Rather than purchasing leads or relying on traditional cold prospecting, representatives connect with qualified client opportunities, including individuals and families who have requested information regarding available benefits.

This allows you to focus on:

Connecting → Understanding Needs → Educating → Recommending → Enrolling → Supporting

No lead purchasing is required.

🏠 100% Remote / Work From Home

Build your career from home while serving clients virtually.

Your work environment may include:

  • Virtual client appointments

  • Zoom meetings

  • Phone consultations

  • Online training

  • Digital enrollment systems

  • Remote coaching and mentorship

  • Virtual team collaboration

There's no daily commute, but successful remote representatives understand that flexibility also requires self-discipline, organization, accountability, and consistent effort.

💰 Weekly Performance-Based Compensation

This is a commission-based independent contractor opportunity rather than an hourly or salaried customer service position.

Compensation opportunities may include:

  • Weekly commission payments

  • Performance-based bonuses

  • Renewal and residual income opportunities

  • Leadership incentives

  • Recognition programs

  • Additional performance-based rewards

Uncapped Commission Potential

There is no predetermined earnings cap on commission-based production. High-performing representatives may have the opportunity to build significant income based on their production and results.

Individual earnings vary significantly based on activity, production, consistency, and performance. No specific income level, including $100,000 annually, is guaranteed.

📚 No Insurance Experience? We'll Train You.

Previous insurance experience is not required.

We provide training and professional development that may include:

  • Structured virtual onboarding

  • Insurance licensing guidance

  • Product and benefits education

  • Customer service training

  • Consultative sales development

  • Client communication techniques

  • Virtual presentation skills

  • Enrollment systems and procedures

  • One-on-one mentorship

  • Weekly coaching

  • Professional development workshops

  • Leadership training

You'll have opportunities to develop transferable skills in customer service, communication, relationship management, organization, sales, problem-solving, presentation, and leadership.

🎓 Insurance Licensing

You do not need to already hold an insurance license to apply.

Because this role involves discussing and enrolling clients in insurance products, representatives must obtain the appropriate state Life & Health Insurance License before conducting activities requiring licensure.

Licensing guidance and support are provided.

🤝 Professional & Union Support

Qualifying representatives may have access to professional representation and support through OPEIU Local 277, where applicable.

Additional qualifying programs may include:

  • Company-supported life insurance

  • Medical insurance reimbursement

  • Accidental Death Benefit coverage

  • Renewal and residual income opportunities

  • Leadership development programs

  • Professional coaching and mentorship

  • Recognition programs

Eligibility and qualification requirements may apply.

📈 Career & Leadership Development

This opportunity is designed for individuals interested in more than simply an entry-level position.

Representatives who demonstrate strong performance, consistency, initiative, and leadership potential may have opportunities to develop into:

Benefits Advisor → Trainer/Mentor → Team Leader → Management → Advanced Leadership

Development opportunities may include:

  • Client relationship management

  • Training and mentorship

  • Team development

  • Coaching

  • Performance management

  • Business development

  • Leadership

Advancement is based on performance and development—not simply tenure.

Leadership opportunities are earned and are not guaranteed.

🏆 Recognition & Performance Incentives

Strong performance may qualify representatives for additional opportunities such as:

  • Performance bonuses

  • Achievement awards

  • Leadership recognition

  • Professional conferences

  • Team events

  • Incentive travel opportunities

  • Contests and performance rewards

  • Additional career advancement opportunities

All incentives are subject to applicable performance and qualification requirements.

Who We're Looking For

You may be a strong fit if you demonstrate:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Strong customer service and interpersonal abilities

  • Active listening and relationship-building skills

  • Positive and professional attitude

  • Self-motivation and personal accountability

  • Strong organizational and time-management abilities

  • Dependability and attention to detail

  • Problem-solving and critical-thinking skills

  • Comfort working independently from home

  • Ability to collaborate within a virtual team

  • Basic computer proficiency

  • Comfort using Zoom and web-based technology

  • Coachability and openness to feedback

  • Goal-oriented and performance-driven mindset

  • Commitment to ethical, client-focused service

Experience That Transfers Well

Previous insurance experience is not required.

Experience in these areas may be especially helpful:

Customer Service • Member Services • Client Relations • Call Centers • Healthcare • Retail • Hospitality • Education • Administrative Support • Banking • Financial Services • Account Management • Sales • Military Service • Recruiting • Leadership

Entry-level candidates, recent graduates, and career changers are encouraged to apply.

We value communication skills, professionalism, work ethic, coachability, and potential as much as previous experience.

Minimum Requirements

Applicants must:

  • Be at least 18 years of age

  • Be physically located within the United States

  • Be legally authorized to work in the United States

  • Have access to a reliable computer or laptop

  • Maintain reliable high-speed internet

  • Have webcam and microphone capability

  • Maintain a quiet, professional workspace

  • Be comfortable communicating with clients through Zoom and phone

  • Be willing to complete required training

  • Be willing and able to obtain the appropriate state Life & Health Insurance License

Virtual Interview Process

Qualified applicants will complete a brief career overview covering:

  • Position responsibilities

  • Customer service and client expectations

  • Commission-based compensation

  • Client opportunity system

  • Insurance licensing requirements

  • Training and mentorship

  • Career advancement opportunities

Candidates interested in continuing will then have the opportunity to participate in a live Zoom interview with our hiring team.

Ready to Start Your Remote Career?

If you're looking for an entry-level work-from-home opportunity where you can help families, develop valuable professional skills, receive ongoing mentorship, and create long-term earning and advancement opportunities through your performance, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply today to be considered for our Entry-Level Remote Customer Service Representative / Benefits Advisor opportunity with AO | Globe Life.

Work From Home. Serve Families. Develop Your Skills. Build Your Future. 🚀

raw.excerpt: About UsAt Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet.
raw.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

  • Sweden

Responsibilities

  • You are the team leader, enabler, point of reference and coach. You will work closely with our prospects and customers by shadowing and improving your team’s technical expertise. You will take care of new team members and you will ensure work loads are equally distributed within the team. You are personable and can provide constructive feedback when necessary. You will help escalate and identify issues quickly and efficiently and you will work with the other team leads and the regional lead to ensure proper regional coordination. The Solution Engineering Manager has a player/coach mindset and the ability/willingness to step into the field when needed, and lead by example. In addition, you will be expected to partner closely with peer sales leaders and drive to revenue targets.
  • To aid your team, you will work closely with every team at Cloudflare, from Sales and Product, through to Engineering and Customer Support. Your goal of customer success should drive you through the entire organization as you seek out and advise your team on how to create scalable solutions for your customer’s needs.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Our Solutions Engineers and Managers come from a wide range of backgrounds: engineering, software development, finance, product management, customer support & project delivery. We're serious about building a diverse team. When hiring we look for diversity of experience combined with genuine curiosity for our technology.
  • Ultimately, you are passionate about technology, have the ability to explain complex technical concepts in easy-to-understand terms, and you like coaching and teaching. You are naturally curious, and an avid builder who is not afraid to get your hands dirty. On the Solutions Engineering team, you will find a collaborative environment where everyone brings different strengths and jumps in to help each other and you will be an integral part of driving that culture.

The Solution Engineering Manager role requires you to have the ability to effectively manage and grow your team, as well as possess the technical prowess expected of a Solutions Engineer. Your capabilities may include a mix of the following:

  • Pre-sales / SE experience in a reputable IT company.
  • Experience as a frontline or second level SE manager role.
  • Strong understanding of the Northern European (Benelux / Nordics) market, proven track record of business engagements with customers in that market.
  • Proven track record of business growth and talent acquisition (team building).
  • Demonstrable experience in coaching, leadership skills and team management
  • Demonstrable experience in understanding and solving escalations, team issues or other management related scenarios
  • Understanding of customers buying decision process and how to influence it, and the ability to make intelligent business decisions to drive to revenue targets
  • Expertise in internet technologies: OSI Model layers 1-7, BGP, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), SSL / TLS
  • Technical curiosity and passion: Cloudflare is at the cutting edge of internet technology, and our Solutions Engineers are viewed as subject-matter experts. It’s incumbent on us to stay up to date not only with Cloudflare’s specific products, but with industry trends.

Bonus Points

  • BSc/MSc or equivalent degree in a technology related field.
  • Demonstrated experience with a scripting or programming language (e.g. Python, JavaScript, Bash, Go) and a desire to expand those skills;
  • Industry and technology certifications
  • Exposure to emerging technical landscape trends, such as Zero Trust and Serverless computing.
  • Experience in Cloud project deployments
  • Speaking one other European language in addition to fluent English

Inter-Team Goals

  • Work directly with the Sales Director of the region in a 1-to-1 alignment.
  • Cultivate cross SE team/office coordination, keep us all connected as one team
  • Facilitate knowledge transfer between SE teams globally.
  • Develop strong relationships outside of SE organization to aid in escalation of issues (product/support/engineering/special projects/marketing/legal/etc)
  • Maintain strong communications with Account Executives and Customer Success leads

Intra-Team Goals

  • Keep the pulse of the team: who is happy, productive, performing. Know each member’s strengths and how they would each like to develop
  • Exemplify and cultivate positive culture traits. Provide support and confidence to team members
  • Effectively deal with performance issues and provide relevant, timely feedback.
  • Cultivate a very open communication environment. Criticism is welcome and appreciated
  • Maintain a culture of independence, collaboration and results focus.

Compensation

For Sweden based hires: Estimated annual salary is between SEK 1,342,000 - SEK 1,846,000.

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

: We released to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actualrace, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. Saint Mary’s College is seeking a Regional Development Director - Remote to build meaningful, long-term relationships between benefactors and the College within a designated region of the United States. This position will support the strategic goals of Saint Mary’s to empower, enrich, and advance women in all stages of life through the power of philanthropy.

As the only women’s college in Indiana and one of fewer than 30 women’s colleges in the country, Saint Mary’s offers a distinctive educational experience that combines a liberal arts education with graduate studies and research opportunities. The College prepares women for leadership in their careers and communities while fostering a campus experience rooted in faith, belonging, and purpose.

Saint Mary’s is experiencing significant momentum through the Ring Out Ring True $200 million comprehensive campaign, centered on three enduring commitments: Empowering Leaders, Enriching Our Community, and Enhancing Our College. The Regional Development Director will play an important role in advancing these priorities through strategic philanthropy and donor engagement.

The Regional Development Director will work closely with academic leaders and Development colleagues to identify, cultivate, solicit, and steward leadership-level philanthropic gifts of $25,000 or more. This position is remote, with a preference for candidates residing in the greater Chicagoland area or Michigan.

Please submit a current resume and cover letter with your application. Your cover letter should highlight your relevant experience, qualifications, and interest in the position.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Five or more years of fundraising experience with demonstrated success cultivating and soliciting gifts of $100,000 or more; or a proven track record of building relationships and closing complex, high-value agreements with decision-makers.
  • Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and prioritization skills, with experience managing complex projects from concept through execution.
  • Excellent critical listening and relationship-building skills.
  • Proven ability to establish priorities and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Strong work ethic and a demonstrated record of achieving professional goals.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • Experience using a Constituent Relationship Management (CRM) system to manage donor relationships and workflow.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated success as a major gifts' fundraiser, preferably within higher education.
  • Basic understanding of relevant tax and estate law and planned giving mechanisms.
  • Experience promoting or supporting gift planning initiatives.
  • Ability to live within a 3–4-hour driving distance of Saint Mary’s College.
  • Preference for candidates residing in the greater Chicagoland area or Michigan.

Job Responsibilities

  • Implement the College’s fundraising strategy focused on the identification, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship of gifts of $25,000 or more.
  • Manage a portfolio of approximately 150 high-level prospects and establish and achieve annual giving and major gift objectives.
  • Develop and implement donor-centered philanthropic engagement plans that connect donors’ interests with the priorities and strategic needs of Saint Mary’s College.
  • Build and maintain significant, long-term relationships with current and prospective benefactors whose philanthropic support is essential to advancing the College’s strategic priorities.
  • Cultivate and solicit leadership-level gifts of $25,000 or more, including demonstrated success in securing gifts of $100,000 or more.
  • Partner with academic leaders, Development colleagues, volunteers, and other College representatives to engage key prospects and donors.
  • Promote the College’s gift planning program and identify opportunities for planned gifts.
  • Prepare and edit written materials for prospective donors, the President, volunteers, and other key stakeholders to support high-level donor engagement.
  • Travel extensively, up to 50%, within the assigned region and nationally as needed to cultivate and strengthen donor relationships.
  • Maintain accurate and timely records of donor interactions, strategies, solicitations, and follow-up activities within the College’s CRM system.
  • Work in partnership with the Executive Director of Regional Development and Gift Planning.
  • Support the success of the Ring Out Ring True comprehensive campaign by advancing philanthropic relationships and securing support for the College’s strategic priorities.

Schedule

Full-time, 12-month position. This is a remote position with extensive travel, up to 50%, within the designated region and as needed to support donor engagement. Preference for candidates living in the greater Chicagoland area or Michigan.

Eligibility to Work

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require visa sponsorship from the College, either now or in the future.

Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Senior Python Data Scraping Engineers to join the Tendem project and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world applications. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in web scraping, data extraction, and data processing to deliver accurate, reliable, and high-quality results. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Senior Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing tools such as Apify, OpenRouter, and other technologies, alongside your own technical expertise and approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage available tools and custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirement.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required).
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern development tools and technologies, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)
  • Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets)

Additional requirements

  • Demonstrated experience handling anti-bot mechanisms and dynamic site structures at scale
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) and containerization (Docker) as part of real workflows
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, OpenRouter, or similar) applied to automation tasks
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently
  • A link to GitHub is a plus
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $30 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution. Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

  • Strong desire to learn new technologies and apply them to real-world business challenges, maintaining high coachability and rapid adaptability.
  • Exceptional attention to detail paired with excellent task management and organizational abilities.
  • Outstanding written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Ability to quickly establish relationships with others, especially over the phone.
  • Effective problem-solving skills used to address prospect and customer issues by actively listening, identifying core needs, and aligning solutions with FMX.
  • A match with our core values: Teamwork, Excellence, and Integrity

The hiring process for this role:

  • Apply! Submit your resume and answers to the application questions below via the Workable portal.
  • Phone screen with PeopleOps: A 30-minute conversation to review your background and experiences, discuss the culture at FMX, and ensure that you understand the general expectations for the role. Also, a great time for you to ask questions about compensation, benefits, etc.
  • Hiring manager conversation: A 60-minute conversation with the Manager, Solutions Engineering. Be prepared to discuss your background as well as what you’re looking for in your next role and what direction you see your career path taking. Also, a great time for you to ask questions about the expectations for this role, team culture, etc.
  • Peer Interview: A casual 30-minute meeting with a Solutions Engineer. This is an opportunity for you to ask any final questions to ensure that the position and FMX is the right fit for you!

Benefits

FMX Benefits and Life at FMX:

  • You’ll make a big impact: You’ll have significant influence over the direction of our product and the future of our company.

We have one all-company events a year to ensure you can put a face to the name and build high-trust relationships with your teammates and co-workers. When you’re in the office, you can take advantage of our free snacks, beverages, and office kegerator.
  • Home office stipend: We’ll give you everything necessary to do your job (company-sponsored laptop, headset, etc.). We will also provide up to $500 to help with equipment, furniture, and accessories. You will also get $60/month toward your home internet connection.
  • Generous PTO and UTO (unplanned time off) policies: If you’re sick, why should that cut into your vacation time?
  • Flexible Schedule: We offer a flexible schedule to help you manage personal appointments, such as doctor or dentist visits, as long as you're meeting performance expectations and project timelines.
  • You’ll enjoy a collaborative culture and a close-knit team: We're a team of hard-working, high-fiving, friendly folks. We take collaboration, transparency, continuous improvement, and work/life balance seriously.

Compensation:

  • This position offers a base salary and is also eligible for a Company Performance Bonus.
  • 401(k) and medical / dental / vision / short and long term disability / life insurance.

Other considerations: The candidate for this position can be located anywhere in the US.

Company:

raw.description:
Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

As a Data Scientist, you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring 3+ YEARS of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.

You will thrive in this role if you are:

  • A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
  • A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing
  • Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
  • Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

Role responsibilities

  • Lead the development of analytical, statistical, machine learning, and applied AI solutions for business and client use cases.
  • Translate business questions into structured analytical approaches, modeling strategies, hypotheses, features, evaluation methods, and measurable outputs.
  • Design and execute analyses and models across use cases such as segmentation, forecasting, propensity modeling, anomaly detection, experimentation analysis, recommendation-oriented analysis, and decision support.
  • Work independently with structured, semi-structured, and selected unstructured datasets to derive insights and develop business-relevant solutions.
  • Build, refine, and maintain notebook-based workflows and reproducible analytical assets in Databricks and other cloud-based environments.
  • Apply machine learning and AI methods to support classification, scoring, summarization, pattern detection, feature generation, and business process improvement use cases.
  • Support the evaluation and practical application of LLM-enabled or AI-assisted workflows where they strengthen business analysis, insight generation, or decision support.
  • Participate in model training, tuning, validation, performance review, and comparative evaluation across different analytical and AI approaches.
  • Document assumptions, methodology, feature logic, model decisions, evaluation criteria, limitations, and findings clearly and consistently.
  • Partner with Data Analysts, AI Scientists, AI Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers, and Architects to ensure solutions align with business needs, data realities, and technical constraints.
  • Improve delivery quality by identifying opportunities for better reproducibility, stronger evaluation practices, clearer documentation, and more scalable analytical workflows.
  • Follow established governance, privacy, and responsible data and AI use standards in day-to-day work.

Must have qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

  • Strong working knowledge of statistics, probability, machine learning, and analytical problem solving.
  • Ability to independently manage recurring data science workstreams and deliver reliable outputs with minimal oversight.
  • Strong understanding of supervised and unsupervised learning approaches, feature engineering, model evaluation, error analysis, and analytical problem framing.
  • Ability to work effectively with structured, semi-structured, and selected unstructured datasets.
  • Working knowledge of experimentation design, model validation, and the interpretation of analytical and predictive outputs in business contexts.
  • Growing familiarity with applied AI methods, including LLM-enabled workflows, text-oriented analysis, and AI-assisted feature extraction or classification.
  • Strong familiarity with notebook-based development and collaborative data science workflows, including Databricks.
  • Strong curiosity about patterns, behaviors, drivers, and how advanced analytical methods support decision-making and business value.
  • Strong attention to detail and disciplined approach to validating data, logic, methodology, and outputs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to explain analytical methods and findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to balance technical rigor with practical business and delivery realities.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across distributed teams in the Americas and work across functions, time zones, and client contexts.

Tools / Platforms

Programming / Data Science

  • Python
  • Jupyter Notebooks
  • Pandas
  • NumPy
  • scikit-learn
  • SciPy
  • Statsmodels
  • XGBoost
  • LightGBM

Data Science Workbench / Lakehouse Platforms

  • Databricks
  • Databricks notebooks
  • Databricks Machine Learning
  • Apache Spark
  • PySpark
  • MLflow

Data & Querying

  • SQL
  • BigQuery
  • Snowflake
  • Other cloud data platforms as needed

Cloud & AI Platforms

  • Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Vertex AI
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Azure AI services
  • Azure Machine Learning
  • Other cloud-based machine learning and analytics platforms as needed

Applied AI / LLM Support

  • OpenAI-compatible APIs or enterprise LLM platforms as relevant to the client environment
  • Prompt evaluation and structured testing workflows
  • Embedding, text analysis, and unstructured data processing patterns
  • Model and workflow evaluation tooling as relevant to the client environment

Visualization / Analysis Support

  • Matplotlib
  • Seaborn
  • Plotly
  • Looker
  • Power BI
  • Tableau

Workflow / Collaboration / Versioning

  • Git
  • GitHub
  • Azure DevOps
  • Other collaboration and code management tools as relevant to the client environment

Certifications

Preferred, not required

  • Databricks associate-level training or certification
  • Google Cloud data, ML, or AI training
  • Microsoft Azure data, ML, or AI training
  • Python, machine learning, experimentation, or applied AI coursework
  • Statistics, forecasting, or analytical modeling training

Collaboration / Stakeholder Expectations

  • Serves as a dependable data science partner to internal teams and client stakeholders across modeling, analysis, and applied AI needs.
  • Collaborates closely with Data Analysts to ensure analytical and predictive outputs connect clearly to reporting, decision-making, and business context.
  • Works with AI Scientists and AI Engineers where use cases involve LLMs, unstructured data, agentic patterns, or more advanced AI solution design.
  • Partners with Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers, and Architects to ensure workflows are supported by scalable data pipelines, governed structures, and reliable environments.
  • Participates confidently in client-facing discussions by explaining methodology, model logic, findings, limitations, and practical implications in clear business language.
  • Helps improve team consistency by strengthening notebooks, documentation, evaluation methods, and reusable analytical practices.

AI Fluency / AI-Assisted Data Science Expectations

Expected to be an active adopter of approved AI-enabled analytical, coding, experimentation, documentation, and productivity workflows that improve the quality and speed of data science work. Uses AI-assisted workflows to support exploratory analysis, feature thinking, code and notebook development, model documentation, experiment design, analytical summarization, and stakeholder communication while maintaining human accountability for method selection, statistical reasoning, validation, interpretation, and final recommendations.

Understands that AI-generated code, modeling suggestions, analytical summaries, or methodological recommendations must be reviewed against source data, assumptions, statistical rigor, business context, governance expectations, and reproducibility standards before use. Demonstrates curiosity and practical enthusiasm for applying AI to improve analytical leverage, decision support, and delivery quality without weakening scientific discipline or human judgment.

At this level, AI fluency means reliable use within workstreams. Expected to apply approved AI-assisted workflows to improve delivery quality, repeatability, documentation, and stakeholder communication, and to help junior practitioners understand where AI can and cannot be used responsibly.

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

  • Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
  • Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
  • Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family, plus employer contributions to Health Savings Accounts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

For applicants in California, please see Valtech's CPRA Privacy Notice here.

raw.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Epic Interface Integration Analyst to design, implement, and support application interfaces and API-based integrations that enable reliable, secure data exchange between clinical systems and external partners. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with Epic interoperability solutions, healthcare integration technologies, FHIR, RESTful APIs, and healthcare data exchange standards.

This role requires strong technical troubleshooting skills, a deep understanding of interoperability frameworks, and the ability to deliver scalable integration solutions that improve clinical and operational outcomes. The Epic Interface Integration Analyst will collaborate with application teams, vendors, business stakeholders, and external partners to support both traditional HL7 integrations and modern API-driven interoperability initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Interface Design, Development & Implementation

  • Lead the full lifecycle of interface development, including requirements gathering, design, build, testing, implementation, go-live support, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Design, implement, and support healthcare integrations leveraging FHIR APIs, RESTful web services, and modern interoperability frameworks.
  • Collaborate with application teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to define interface requirements and resolve integration-related issues.
  • Coordinate interface testing, cutover planning, and go-live activities to ensure successful deployments.
  • Partner with interface engine developers to design data translation and transformation logic supporting EHR and third-party system integrations.
  • Support integrations between Epic and internal or external applications using both traditional and modern interoperability methodologies.
  • Participate in the evaluation, design, and implementation of interoperability solutions that support real-time clinical and operational data exchange.

Production Support & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor production interfaces proactively and drive permanent resolution of interface issues through root cause analysis and corrective action.
  • Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve issues related to HL7 messages, FHIR resources, APIs, authentication mechanisms, and data exchange workflows.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex integration and interoperability issues.
  • Analyze integration workflows and data to identify opportunities for optimization, automation, and improved performance.
  • Ensure integration solutions comply with organizational security, privacy, and data governance requirements.

Documentation & Process Improvement

  • Develop and maintain interface documentation, testing plans, support procedures, and technical specifications.
  • Create and maintain integration architecture documentation and data flow diagrams.
  • Support system upgrades, application enhancements, and interoperability initiatives.
  • Contribute to best practices and standards for interface development, support, and monitoring.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as assigned to support evolving organizational needs.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Certifications

  • Epic Bridges Certification required and must be maintained as a condition of employment.

Experience

  • Minimum of 6 years of experience in an IT, systems integration, interface, or interoperability-related role.
  • Experience supporting healthcare application integrations and data exchange between clinical systems and external partners.
  • Hands-on experience supporting FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) implementations and API-based healthcare integrations.
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs, JSON, XML, web services, and healthcare interoperability technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience troubleshooting and supporting healthcare interoperability solutions in production environments.
  • Experience coordinating testing, implementation, cutover, and go-live support activities.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong analytical, technical, and troubleshooting skills in complex integration environments.
  • Understanding of healthcare interoperability standards, including HL7 v2, FHIR, APIs, and modern integration architectures.
  • Ability to analyze data, identify root causes, and communicate solutions effectively.
  • Understanding of how business and operational requirements translate into technical integration designs.
  • Strong coordination and project management skills across multiple teams and vendors.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment.
  • Strong customer service orientation and commitment to operational excellence.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Epic Bridges interfaces.
  • Experience implementing and supporting Epic Interconnect, Epic FHIR APIs, SMART on FHIR, or other Epic interoperability solutions.
  • Experience with interface engines and integration platforms.
  • Experience supporting EHR integrations and third-party vendor connectivity.
  • Experience with API management platforms such as Azure API Management, MuleSoft, Boomi, or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and API security best practices.
  • Experience coordinating testing, cutover, and go-live activities for complex healthcare technology initiatives.
  • Experience supporting population health, payer-provider, HIE, laboratory, pharmacy, or third-party healthcare integrations utilizing FHIR standards.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based integration technologies and interoperability frameworks.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

  • 100% Remote Work
  • 100% Employer-Paid Medical Insurance
  • Annual $1,500 HSA Contribution
  • Generous PTO
  • 403(b) Retirement Plan with Employer Contribution
  • Professional Development & Education Assistance
  • Mission-Driven Culture Focused on Community Health

    • Collaborate with marketing, content, and design teams on campaign and website initiatives

What You Bring:

  • 2+ years experience building and maintaining WordPress websites
    • Strong proficiency in WordPress, PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
    • Experience using page builders such as Elementor, Divi, or WPBakery
    • Strong understanding of responsive design and front-end user experience
    • Experience optimizing WordPress performance, page speed, and Core Web Vitals
    • Familiarity with SEO best practices and WordPress SEO tools such as Yoast SEO
    • Experience managing hosting environments including cPanel, WP Engine, SiteGround, or Kinsta
    • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
    • Excellent attention to detail and ability to maintain clean, polished websites
    • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in remote environments

Nice to Have:

  • WooCommerce development and e-commerce experience
    • Experience building or extending WordPress plugins using PHP
    • Familiarity with Git, CI/CD workflows, and staging deployments
    • Experience working in marketing agencies, SaaS, or service-based businesses
    • Basic understanding of UX/UI principles and conversion-focused design

Key Success Metrics:

  • On-time delivery of website updates and development tasks
    • Fast-loading, responsive, and optimized websites
    • Core Web Vitals maintained at high performance scores
    • Minimal website downtime and security issues
    • Strong collaboration with marketing and content teams
    • Reduced bugs, plugin conflicts, and technical issues over time

Why You’ll Love This Role:

  • High-impact role contributing directly to website performance and digital growth
    • Opportunity to work on a variety of WordPress websites and campaigns
    • Fully remote flexibility with ownership and autonomy
    • Exposure to SEO, web performance optimization, UX, and front-end development
    • Work closely with marketing, design, and leadership teams
    • Long-term growth opportunity within web development and digital operations

Ready to build fast, responsive, and high-performing WordPress websites? Apply now with examples of websites, landing pages, or WordPress projects you’ve built or managed.

  • Human-Centered: We prioritize well-being and flexibility for our employees.

  • Celebrating Excellence: We recognize and reward outstanding contributions.

Service New Brunswick is seeking an individual to join the Business Application Services Branch as a Programmer Analyst.

Who are you?

  • You demonstrate initiative and are adaptable, organized and solution oriented.
  • You are an effective communicator and collaborator.

What will you be doing?

Your responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

What do you need to be successful?

A university degree in Computer Science or a related field and a minimum of four (4) years related experience in system development OR a two (2) year college diploma in Information Technology with a minimum of four (4) years related experience in system development.

Demonstrated recent experience utilizing one or more of the following is required:

  • .NET Framework Development (C#, VB.NET. .NET Core (C#) or Java development or Oracle forms development.

    and

Applicants must clearly demonstrate the essential qualifications to be given further consideration. Please state your language capability on your application and ensure that preferred language for assessment is clearly identified.

ASSET QUALIFICATIONS: Preference may be given to candidates who demonstrate they have training or experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Demonstrated experience applying software development methodologies, with a focus on business analysis and systems requirements development.

  • Experience with development process tools such as Azure DevOps, JIRA, Confluence, etc.

  • Experience with development tools such for .Net Core/.Net Framework, Visual Studio, SSRS, Oracle Forms, Oracle APEX, Oracle Business Analytics, etc.
  • Experience in database development tools for SQL or Oracle

Subject to the response to this competition, candidates may be required to demonstrate on their application one or more of the asset qualifications in addition to the essential qualifications to be given further consideration.

OPERATIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Some weekday evening and weekend work hours may be required on occasion.
  • Candidates will be required to undergo Criminal History Clearance prior to appointment.

CORE COMPETENCIES: The successful candidate will possess the following core competencies:

  • Analytical Thinking/Judgment

  • Effective Interactive Communication

  • Teamwork and Collaboration

  • Client Service & Result Orientation

TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES: The successful candidate will possess the following technical competencies:

  • Ability to Use M365 Technology, Software, Application
  • Specialized Subject Matter Expertise and Knowledge
  • Planning and Organizing Skills
  • Written communication

Resumes should be in chronological order specifying education and employment in months and years including part-time and full-time employment.

Description

Upwind is a next-generation Cloud Security Platform that leverages runtime context to identify and prioritize critical risks, providing precise insights and efficient cloud security management. Unlike traditional tools, Upwind uses runtime data proactively for risk prioritization and posture insights, ensuring teams focus on what truly matters. With industry-leading efficiency and eBPF-powered sensors, Upwind delivers comprehensive capabilities, including agentless cloud posture discovery, real-time threat protection, and integrated API security. From misconfigurations to malware defense, Upwind ensures end-to-end, cost-effective cloud infrastructure protection. At Upwind, you’ll have the opportunity to think creatively, explore new ideas, and use your skills to make a meaningful impact on our growth.

We're looking for a Technical Account Manager to build strong, strategic relationships with customers and ensure successful onboarding, adoption, and long-term value from the Upwind platform. You'll serve as the main point of contact, guide technical deployments, lead roadmap discussions, and provide hands-on support to drive engagement and satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a strategic partner to the sales team post-sale, supporting account continuity while enabling sales to focus on new opportunities
  • Lead the technical deployment of the Upwind platform post-sale, ensuring smooth and successful onboarding and deployment of new capabilities
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, addressing issues quickly and maintaining a high-quality customer experience
  • Build strong, long-term relationships by introducing new features, gathering feedback, and leading roadmap discussions
  • Partner with sales during renewals and expansion to align technical planning with customer needs and drive value
  • Proactively engage with customers to surface key security insights, guide feature adoption, and ensure they realize the full value of the Upwind platform
  • Understand and advocate for your customers needs cross functionally (i.e. Product Management and Technical Support)

Requirements

  • 3+ years in customer-facing roles in SaaS, with experience in Technical Account Management, Solution Architecture, or similar roles
  • Strong technical background in cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), cybersecurity, or DevOps
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and relationship-building skills
  • Experience leading technical projects, managing cloud deployments, and driving feature adoption
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to align technical solutions to business goals
  • Relevant certifications in cloud or security (preferred)

Description

TripleTen es una plataforma que empodera a las personas, independientemente de su experiencia previa, para embarcarse en el emocionante y crucial camino de dominar profesiones tecnológicas. Nuestros bootcamps se enfocan en formar estudiantes en Web Development, Data Science, Data Analysis, QA Engineering, UX/UI Design y Cybersecurity, haciendo que estos campos sean accesibles y alcanzables para todos, para que puedan prosperar en una nueva carrera.

Nuestra misión es asegurar que cada estudiante tenga la oportunidad de dominar una profesión tecnológica, encontrar su propósito y convertirse en un valioso contribuidor en la industria tech. Estamos buscando expertos deCiberseguridad apasionados por la seguridad informática, con experiencia práctica y vocación para guiar a principiantes mientras construyen una base sólida en este campo clave. Este rol requiere sólidos conocimientos técnicos en ciberseguridad, habilidades de comunicación claras y empatía para apoyar e inspirar a estudiantes que están dando sus primeros pasos en esta área.

﻿¿Te gustaría ayudar a construir el futuro de otras personas a través de la educación tecnológica?

➡️ Te pedimos amablemente que envíes tu CV en inglés.

What you will do

Como experto en proyectos, liderarás a una cohorte de estudiantes a lo largo de nuestro programa de Cybersecurity, compartiendo tu experiencia e inspirándolos con tu conocimiento de la industria. Apoyarás a los estudiantes respondiendo sus preguntas y brindándoles orientación práctica de las siguientes maneras:

  • Impartiendo webinars quincenales enfocados en proyectos, guiando a los estudiantes en la aplicación práctica de conceptos de ciberseguridad y en escenarios reales.
  • Revisando los proyectos de los estudiantes y proporcionando retroalimentación detallada y constructiva dentro de las 24 horas posteriores a su entrega (esto requiere disponibilidad parcial y flexible durante los fines de semana).
  • Realizando sesiones de mentoría 1:1 bajo demanda, enfocadas en los proyectos, para ayudar a los estudiantes a superar dificultades técnicas y mantenerse motivados durante el programa.
  • Respondiendo preguntas relacionadas con los proyectos en Discord, ayudando a los estudiantes a resolver problemas y profundizar su comprensión de las prácticas de ciberseguridad.
  • Actuando como el experto y mentor de referencia, acompañando a los estudiantes mientras desarrollan sus proyectos y fortalecen sus habilidades en ciberseguridad.

Requirements

Requerimos al menos 3 años de experiencia práctica en ciberseguridad, con conocimientos en las siguientes áreas:

• Network & Architecture: comprensión de redes planas vs. segmentadas, DMZ y estrategias para reducir la superficie de ataque y el blast radius.

• Authentication & Access Abuse: conocimiento de riesgos relacionados con accesos privilegiados, uso de RDP y exportaciones sospechosas de datos.

• Incident Analysis: capacidad para investigar eventos como intentos fallidos de inicio de sesión, restablecimientos de contraseña y actividad sospechosa en cuentas utilizando frameworks como MITRE ATT&CK.

• Log Analysis: experiencia analizando logs de sistemas y seguridad para detectar anomalías o comportamientos sospechosos.

• Python Scripting: capacidad para escribir scripts que procesen logs, cuenten eventos y extraigan información útil.

• Capacidad para explicar conceptos técnicos complejos de manera clara a principiantes.

• Paciencia y empatía al apoyar a estudiantes que están iniciando en ciberseguridad.

• Nivel de inglés B1.

﻿Ventajas adicionales:

• Experiencia previa enseñando o mentoreando.

• Experiencia guiando a principiantes en temas técnicos con explicaciones paso a paso.

What we can offer you

Capacitación en técnicas de mentoría y comunicación.

  • Colaboración flexible, remota y de medio tiempo — trabaja 10-18 horas por semana.
  • Compartir experiencia con desarrolladores dentro de nuestra comunidad.
  • Ingresos promedio de $600 USD al mes por una colaboración flexible de medio tiempo, con gran impacto ¡y un equipo increíble!
  • Experiencia de colaboración intercultural en mentoría y realización de webinars.
  • Cooperación remota con un horario conveniente tanto para ti como para el equipo. No nos enfocamos en la microgestión.
  • Una oficina digital cómoda. Utilizamos herramientas digitales modernas — Miro, Notion, Zoom, etc. — para que el trabajo conjunto sea fluido.
  • Un equipo diverso y unido distribuido entre EE.UU. y América Latina.

¡Estamos emocionados de conocerte y trabajar contigo! ?
