Seeking curious and creative types! We are an ambitious company of innovators building and shaping the future of customer service technology. Our solutions help the world’s biggest brands leverage artificial intelligence, machine learning, and digital automation in their contact centers to deliver better customer experiences. Led by a team of established contact center experts, Laivly addresses the unique needs and challenges of customer service programs, with an emphasis on ethics in AI and the customer service agent experience.

This role is remote and open to all Canadian residents.

About the role

This is not a traditional Customer Success Role.

Laivly is looking for a Customer Success Manager who can walk into a complex customer environment, quickly understand what matters, and turn ambitious ideas into measurable results. You’ll own relationships with Enterprise and SME clients using Sidd, our AI-powered platform for transforming customer service operations.

You’ll be part strategic advisor, part account leader, and part operator. You’ll build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, bring structure to ambiguity, and keep customers moving from opportunity through implementation, adoption, renewal, and expansion. You’ll work closely with Technical Solutions, Product, and Engineering to solve difficult problems, while remaining accountable for the customer relationship and business outcome.

This role is for someone who prepares deeply, communicates exceptionally well, and develops an informed point of view instead of simply reporting status. Our strongest CSMs spot risks early, ask sharp questions, create momentum, and confidently guide both customers and internal teams toward the right outcome.

You’ll enjoy this role if you are curious, commercially minded, highly accountable, and energized by building inside a fast-moving AI company.

As CSM, you will:

  • Own the overall customer lifecycle and account strategy, from onboarding through adoption, value realization, renewal, and expansion, partnering with deployment and technical teams during implementation
  • Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and become a credible advisor on how AI and automation can improve their operations
  • Create account plans that connect customer priorities, solution delivery, measurable outcomes, risks, and growth opportunities
  • Surface customer priorities, business requirements, and operational challenges, partnering with technical teams on detailed discovery, workflow mapping, and solution design
  • Coordinate the right internal resources to address customer risks, remove barriers to adoption, and ensure issues are resolved with clear ownership and communication
  • Bring structure and momentum to complex situations, ensuring decisions are made, commitments are clear, and open items are driven to completion
  • Identify account risks before they become urgent and lead clear mitigation plans across client and internal stakeholders
  • Act as the voice of the customer, providing structured feedback to product, engineering, and leadership
  • Lead strategic and operational business reviews that demonstrate value, surface decisions, and establish accountability for next steps.
  • Challenge customers and internal teams constructively when decisions or delays put the intended outcome at risk.
  • Mentor and guide junior team members, helping to scale the CSM function at Laivly

As CSM, you have:

  • You have 3–5+ years of experience in strategic customer success, consulting, solutions consulting, technical account management, product, or another complex client-facing role
  • You are an exceptional communicator who can establish credibility with senior executives, operational leaders, and technical stakeholders
  • You prepare thoroughly, ask thoughtful questions, and quickly develop an informed point of view
  • You can take an ambiguous customer problem, create structure around it, and drive people toward a decision and plan
  • You have strong commercial judgment and understand how customer outcomes connect to retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • You are proactive and highly accountable. You do not wait for someone else to identify the next step or chase you for an update
  • You can manage strong personalities, navigate difficult conversations, and challenge stakeholders constructively
  • You are analytically minded and comfortable using data to assess results, identify risks, and recommend action
  • You are technically curious and comfortable learning how APIs, AI tools, LLMs, and automation products work
  • You are energized by startup environments where priorities move quickly and the playbook is still being built
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, AI and automation, contact centres, or digital transformation is an asset

Life at Laivly

Laivly gives you the opportunity to collaborate and grow your career with a creative, diverse, and passionate team. We work hard and play often, with a flexible environment that works with you. A career at Laivly means being part of a fun-loving, dedicated team of creatives, risk takers and game changers. It’s about sharing your talent and imagination to develop innovative tech that’s revolutionizing the way top brands interact with the world.

We’ve got a shared mission—and a Laivly future. Join us today!

Navitus - Putting People First in Pharmacy - Navitus was founded as an alternative to traditional pharmacy benefit manager (PBM) models. 17.50 - Sr Director

M-F 8am to 5pm

Remote Work Notification

ATTENTION: Navitus is unable to offer remote work to residents of Alaska, Hawaii, Maine, Mississippi, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, West Virginia, and Wyoming.

Overview

We're seeking an accomplished PBM and managed care leader with a bachelor's degree, 10+ years of experience supporting managed care clients, and 5+ years of experience leading and developing high-performing teams. This role offers the opportunity to leverage your expertise with executive-level consultants and clients to drive strategy, strengthen relationships, and deliver meaningful results. If you're passionate about influencing the future of pharmacy benefits and helping clients achieve better outcomes, you'll find both challenge and impact in this leadership role.

The Sr. Director, Account Services leads strategy, overall service performance, and account service teams for existing PBM clients. The position is responsible for the co-development of long-term account strategy for the Key Account’s clients. This position communicates across multiple organizational levels including internal/external and leads Client Services teams/projects. Working with subject matter experts, the Sr. Director is responsible for developing and executing an annual Strategic Business Plan with account teams and clients. The position is responsible for supporting client retention, achieving corporate strategic goals relative to client base and overall customer satisfaction, including removing obstacles/solving customer issues in a timely manner. This includes mentoring, providing guidance, training, performance reviews, and other such managerial tasks. This position also provides support to the team through participation in key strategic Client Consultative Reviews and Strategic Business Plan meetings and other client meetings as required. In addition, the Sr. Director strengthens organizational capability and operational effectiveness through process modernization, implementation of centralized resources, cross-training initiatives, and the adoption of technology-enabled, data-driven decision making.

This role is ideal for an accomplished healthcare leader who enjoys building strong client partnerships, leading high-performing teams, influencing strategy, and delivering meaningful results in a mission-driven organization focused on making medications more affordable and accessible.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Provide leadership and oversight for Account Executives and Account Management strategy and tactical execution, ensuring consistent service delivery, and driving performance across account management teams supporting the Key Accounts book of business. This includes accountability for operational effectiveness, scalability, and alignment with company objectives.
  • Communicate effectively with Senior Team at Navitus and C-Suite level externally; provide executive summary of performance to the Executive Team at least quarterly.
  • Attend key Management Committee meetings.
  • Oversee the creation and presentation of Strategic Business Plans, Consultative QBRs, and Performance Standard reports to Navitus clients.
  • Provide support and guidance to staff relative to Performance Guarantees and best practices.
  • Manage Clients at a strategic level, including Senior-level Client Management teams.
  • Build sustainable operational capability by modernizing processes, establishing centralized documentation and standards, promoting cross-training, and reinforcing governance practices (decision-making, accountability, and escalation frameworks).
  • Champion data-driven decision-making and technology adoption to improve efficiency and consistency across Account Management Operations.
  • Involvement in related cross-functional matrix teams/committees.
  • Lead internal department and corporate projects.
  • Responsible for measuring, monitoring, and reporting a variety of key performance indicators for internal and external stakeholders; and for reporting client services metrics.
  • Responsible for team members’ performance specific to client, individual team members, and key office personnel.
  • Create and develop strategic direction for the Client / Clinical Services team.
  • Provide on-going formal training to team members.
  • Promote and oversee intentional cross-training strategies within and across departments to reduce single points of failure, strengthen bench strength, and improve service continuity for complex consultant/broker portfolios.
  • Provide expert input to hiring process and on-boarding process for team members.
  • Travel to Client sites as required.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

What our team expects from you?

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university required.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience interfacing directly with Managed Care clients required.
  • 5+ years of progressive leadership experience, which may include leading individual contributors or teams, or equivalent leadership experience such as coaching, mentoring, or leading complex initiatives or projects, required.
  • Knowledge of internal operations, as well as an knowledge of the clients’ benefit management philosophy, goals, and objectives required.
  • Understanding of the PBM industry and the Navitus advantage as compared with its competitors required.
  • Knowledge of formulary managed care systems, principles, and practices (e.g., DUR, and prior authorization) required.
  • Participate in, adhere to, and support compliance program objectives.
  • The ability to consistently interact cooperatively and respectfully with other employees.

What can you expect from Navitus?

  • Top of the industry benefits for Health, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • 20 days paid time off
  • 4 weeks paid parental leave
  • 9 paid holidays
  • 401K company match of up to 5% - No vesting requirement
  • Adoption Assistance Program
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Educational Assistance Plan and Professional Membership assistance
  • Referral Bonus Program – up to $750!

Job Description:

Job Title:Director, Policy Governance(Solventum)

3M Health Care is now Solventum

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

The Director, Policy Governance owns the enterprise-wide framework for how corporate policies are created, organized, maintained, communicated, and retired. This role ensures the organization has a single, authoritative, and easily navigable source of truth for its policies — and that those policies are necessary, clear, and enforceable rather than a source of friction or risk. The Director partners with Legal, Compliance, HR, IT, Finance, and business unit leaders to build a governance model that balances risk mitigation with organizational speed and productivity.

Core Responsibilities

  • Policy Architecture: Create and oversee a centralized policy structure and a searchable repository for all corporate policies. 

  • Cross-Functional Governance: Lead Policy Governance to ensure policies are understandable, effective and necessary and do not create unnecessary barriers to productivity and innovation.

  • Modernization & Maintenance: Develop and manage process to update or retire policies to reflect changing business, legal and regulatory requirements. 

  • Change Management: Develop communication strategies to ensure employees at all levels understand policies applicable to them and how to follow them.

  • Risk Mitigation: Identify "policy gaps" that could expose the company to legal, financial, or reputational damage and draft proactive solutions.

Your Skills and Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited institution in Law, Business Administration, Public Administration, Human Resources, Organizational Development, or a related field. An advanced degree (JD, MBA, or Master's degree) preferred.

  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience in a corporate environment in the areas of Corporate Governance, Legal, Compliance, Human Resources, Ethics & Compliance, or a related discipline, including significant experience developing, implementing, or managing corporate policies and governance frameworks.

  • Policy & Governance Expertise:Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional policy initiatives, interpret complex regulatory or business requirements, and translate them into practical, employee-friendly guidance.

Description

TripleTen es una plataforma que empodera a las personas, independientemente de su experiencia previa, para embarcarse en el emocionante y crucial camino de dominar profesiones tecnológicas. Nuestros bootcamps se enfocan en formar estudiantes en Web Development, Data Science, Data Analysis, QA Engineering, UX/UI Design y Cybersecurity, haciendo que estos campos sean accesibles y alcanzables para todos, para que puedan prosperar en una nueva carrera.

Nuestra misión es asegurar que cada estudiante tenga la oportunidad de dominar una profesión tecnológica, encontrar su propósito y convertirse en un valioso contribuidor en la industria tech. Estamos buscando expertos deCiberseguridad apasionados por la seguridad informática, con experiencia práctica y vocación para guiar a principiantes mientras construyen una base sólida en este campo clave. Este rol requiere sólidos conocimientos técnicos en ciberseguridad, habilidades de comunicación claras y empatía para apoyar e inspirar a estudiantes que están dando sus primeros pasos en esta área.

﻿¿Te gustaría ayudar a construir el futuro de otras personas a través de la educación tecnológica?

➡️ Te pedimos amablemente que envíes tu CV en inglés.

What you will do

Como experto en proyectos, liderarás a una cohorte de estudiantes a lo largo de nuestro programa de Cybersecurity, compartiendo tu experiencia e inspirándolos con tu conocimiento de la industria. Apoyarás a los estudiantes respondiendo sus preguntas y brindándoles orientación práctica de las siguientes maneras:

  • Impartiendo webinars quincenales enfocados en proyectos, guiando a los estudiantes en la aplicación práctica de conceptos de ciberseguridad y en escenarios reales.
  • Revisando los proyectos de los estudiantes y proporcionando retroalimentación detallada y constructiva dentro de las 24 horas posteriores a su entrega (esto requiere disponibilidad parcial y flexible durante los fines de semana).
  • Realizando sesiones de mentoría 1:1 bajo demanda, enfocadas en los proyectos, para ayudar a los estudiantes a superar dificultades técnicas y mantenerse motivados durante el programa.
  • Respondiendo preguntas relacionadas con los proyectos en Discord, ayudando a los estudiantes a resolver problemas y profundizar su comprensión de las prácticas de ciberseguridad.
  • Actuando como el experto y mentor de referencia, acompañando a los estudiantes mientras desarrollan sus proyectos y fortalecen sus habilidades en ciberseguridad.

Requirements

Requerimos al menos 3 años de experiencia práctica en ciberseguridad, con conocimientos en las siguientes áreas:

• Network & Architecture: comprensión de redes planas vs. segmentadas, DMZ y estrategias para reducir la superficie de ataque y el blast radius.

• Authentication & Access Abuse: conocimiento de riesgos relacionados con accesos privilegiados, uso de RDP y exportaciones sospechosas de datos.

• Incident Analysis: capacidad para investigar eventos como intentos fallidos de inicio de sesión, restablecimientos de contraseña y actividad sospechosa en cuentas utilizando frameworks como MITRE ATT&CK.

• Log Analysis: experiencia analizando logs de sistemas y seguridad para detectar anomalías o comportamientos sospechosos.

• Python Scripting: capacidad para escribir scripts que procesen logs, cuenten eventos y extraigan información útil.

• Capacidad para explicar conceptos técnicos complejos de manera clara a principiantes.

• Paciencia y empatía al apoyar a estudiantes que están iniciando en ciberseguridad.

• Nivel de inglés B1.

﻿Ventajas adicionales:

• Experiencia previa enseñando o mentoreando.

• Experiencia guiando a principiantes en temas técnicos con explicaciones paso a paso.

What we can offer you

Capacitación en técnicas de mentoría y comunicación.

  • Colaboración flexible, remota y de medio tiempo — trabaja 10-18 horas por semana.
  • Compartir experiencia con desarrolladores dentro de nuestra comunidad.
  • Ingresos promedio de $600 USD al mes por una colaboración flexible de medio tiempo, con gran impacto ¡y un equipo increíble!
  • Experiencia de colaboración intercultural en mentoría y realización de webinars.
  • Cooperación remota con un horario conveniente tanto para ti como para el equipo. No nos enfocamos en la microgestión.
  • Una oficina digital cómoda. Utilizamos herramientas digitales modernas — Miro, Notion, Zoom, etc. — para que el trabajo conjunto sea fluido.
  • Un equipo diverso y unido distribuido entre EE.UU. y América Latina.

¡Estamos emocionados de conocerte y trabajar contigo! ?

raw.title: Sr. People Business Partner
raw.excerpt: From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity.
raw.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

You'll spend much of your time helping managers tackle the things that make leading people hard: giving clear feedback, addressing performance early, navigating change, building effective teams, and making good decisions when the answer isn't obvious. We don't expect you to have a playbook for everything. We do expect you to be curious, use good judgment, ask the right questions, and be comfortable forming a point of view. We're looking for a People Business Partner / Senior People Business Partner to join our Regional HRBP team and support managers across North America. Our Regional HRBP model is new, so you'll also help us build it. You'll work closely with Functional HRBPs and partners across the People team, learning from what you see on the ground and helping us create better, simpler ways of working as we grow. You'll report to the Director, Regional HR Business Partners.

What You’ll Do

  • Coach managers. Help managers work through performance, feedback, development, conflict, team dynamics, and difficult people decisions. The goal isn't to solve everything for them, it's to help them become better managers.
  • Get underneath the problem. What first lands as a performance issue might actually be unclear expectations, a struggling manager, a team dynamic, or something else entirely. You'll ask good questions, understand the context, and help determine what needs to happen next.
  • Handle complex people matters. You'll lead performance and employee relations work across North America, balancing good judgment, employee experience, business needs, consistency, and risk. You'll know what you can handle yourself and when to bring in Legal or another People partner.
  • Help teams perform better. You'll work with managers on team health, engagement, talent, performance, and change using both what you're hearing and what the data tells us.
  • Spot patterns. We don't want to solve the same problem five times without asking why it keeps happening. You'll connect dots across teams, use data where it helps, and bring emerging themes and risks to the right people.
  • Work closely with Functional HRBPs. They'll bring the broader functional and leadership context; you'll bring what you're seeing with managers, employees, and teams across the region. You'll work together without duplicating each other's roles.
  • Help us build. This is a new model and not everything will be perfectly defined on day one. You'll help us figure out what works, challenge what doesn't, and build approaches we can scale.
  • Look for a better way. We're interested in where technology, automation, and AI can remove repetitive work or help us make better decisions. You don't need to be an AI expert—we do want you to be curious and willing to experiment.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • You've worked as a People/HR Business Partner, or in a role where you've coached managers and dealt with meaningful people and team challenges.
  • You have strong working knowledge of US employment practices. Experience supporting employees across multiple US states is strongly preferred; broader North American experience is a plus.
  • You're a strong manager coach. You can be supportive without simply agreeing, and you're comfortable saying the thing that needs to be said.
  • You have good judgment. When something messy lands, you can work out what matters, what the risks are, and what you'd recommend doing.
  • You're agile. Priorities change, organizations change, and sometimes the plan changes. You can adjust quickly and keep moving.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You don't need every process or boundary defined before you can make progress.
  • You're interested in the business behind the people question. You want to understand what a team is trying to accomplish before deciding what good People support looks like.
  • You can work independently without operating in a silo. You know when to make the call, when to ask for another perspective, and when something needs to be escalated.
  • You notice patterns. You're interested not only in solving today's issue but in understanding why it's happening and whether we're seeing it elsewhere.
  • You're comfortable working across teams, functions, and time zones in a distributed company.

Bonus Skills​

You don't need all of these, but we'd be particularly interested if:

  • You enjoy working with data and have used engagement, performance, attrition, workforce, or other People data to investigate a problem or challenge an assumption.
  • You've worked with or are interested in People analytics or visualization tools. You don't need to be an analyst—we care more about whether you're curious enough to ask the next question.
  • You're interested in AI and how it could change the way managers and People teams work.
  • You've helped build or improve something rather than only operating within an established model.
  • You've worked through a merger, integration, rapid growth, or significant organizational change.

LI-Hybrid

The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level, and may include sales incentives or target bonuses depending on the role. Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Our job titles may span more than one career level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, business need, market demands. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process.

Pay Range
$115,719—$138,868 USD

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays (including a year end Global Week of Rest), and volunteer days off
  • RSU stock grants*
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video.

To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here.

We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form. We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.

raw.title: Finance Manager
raw.excerpt: About FrontierFrontier is a subsidiary of Fresh Prints.
raw.description:
About Frontier

Frontier is a subsidiary of Fresh Prints. Fresh Prints is a New York-based, fast-growing, fully remote, 150-person company with most of our team based in India and the Philippines. A few years ago, Fresh Prints began helping other fast-growing companies build their teams. We got so good at it that we spun out a new company to focus exclusively on that — and called it Frontier.

At Frontier, we help companies grow full-time, cross-functional teams abroad. We hire the smartest people and place them into the best companies. In three years, we’ve never lost a client. If you’re interested in a Frontier role and you apply and are accepted, we’ll screen you through assessments and interviews and aim to get you an interview for a full-time job within the month.

Think of us as your personal talent agent — and good luck with the application! 😊

Please note: To ensure we find the best technical fit, our process begins with a practical skills assessment prior to interviews.

About Oak Hill Bio

Oak Hill Bio is a clinical-stage, rare disease therapeutics company focused on developing life-changing treatments for patients with urgent unmet needs. We are passionate about translating cutting-edge science into meaningful therapies and building a collaborative culture that drives innovation and impact.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Finance Manager / FP&A Lead to join our growing finance team and play a key role across our US and UK operations.

This is a hands-on role that combines FP&A, financial reporting, accounting, and month/quarter-end close responsibilities. The successful candidate will work closely with the US and UK Controllers and have the opportunity to support a complex, multi-group biotech organization.

The role will report directly to the Finance leadership team and will be responsible for helping ensure the accurate, timely, and high-quality delivery of financial reporting and close processes, while also providing meaningful financial analysis and insight to support business decisions.

We are particularly interested in candidates with biotech or life sciences experience, strong technical accounting knowledge, and experience working across US and UK reporting environments.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Analysis

  • Lead and support FP&A activities, including budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and variance analysis.

  • Provide meaningful analysis and insights into financial performance, trends, and business drivers.

  • Partner with business and finance stakeholders to develop financial plans and forecasts.

  • Translate financial data into clear insights and recommendations for leadership.

  • Support scenario analysis and longer-term financial planning.

Financial Reporting & Close

  • Support the accurate and timely completion of monthly and quarterly close processes across US and UK entities.

  • Work closely with the US and UK Controllers to ensure completeness and accuracy of financial information.

  • Review financial results, investigate variances, and identify potential accounting or reporting issues.

  • Support preparation and review of management and financial reporting.

  • Assist with US/SEC reporting requirements and related financial information.

  • Help ensure consistent accounting and reporting practices across the group.

Accounting & Technical Finance

  • Apply strong knowledge of US GAAP and UK GAAP across a multi-entity environment.

  • Support technical accounting matters and ensure appropriate accounting treatment for complex transactions.

  • Work closely with Controllers and other finance stakeholders on accounting issues and reporting requirements.

  • Develop a detailed understanding of the group's operations, entities, and financial activities.

  • Be willing to roll up your sleeves and get into the detail when required rather than operating solely at a high-level FP&A or management-reporting level.

Business Partnership

  • Partner closely with finance and operational teams across the US and UK.

  • Build strong working relationships with Controllers and other key stakeholders.

  • Help improve financial processes, reporting, controls, and systems.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline and improve the efficiency and accuracy of finance processes.

  • Support ad hoc financial analysis and projects as the business evolves.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Qualified accountant (e.g., ACA, ACCA, CPA, or equivalent).

  • Significant experience in finance, FP&A, financial reporting, or a combination of these areas.

  • Strong biotech or life sciences industry experience is essential.

  • Strong knowledge of US GAAP and familiarity with UK GAAP.

  • Experience with US/SEC reporting and related financial reporting requirements.

  • Experience supporting month-end and quarter-end close processes.

  • Strong financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, and analytical capabilities.

  • Experience working within a multi-entity or multi-group organization.

  • Strong understanding of financial statements and accounting principles.

  • Excellent Excel and financial analysis skills.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work accurately under deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working across US and UK finance teams.

  • Experience in a public company or SEC reporting environment.

  • Experience with biotech, pharmaceutical, life sciences, or another highly regulated industry.

  • Experience with ERP systems and financial reporting tools.

  • Experience improving finance processes and controls.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical accounting expertise with commercial and analytical thinking.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable moving between high-level FP&A work and detailed accounting analysis. They will be naturally curious, hands-on, highly analytical, and able to understand how different entities and business activities connect within a complex group structure.

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to have a meaningful impact on the finance function while working closely with experienced Controllers and senior finance leadership.

raw.title: Virtual Assistant - MedSpa Sales & Front Desk
raw.excerpt: Virtual Assistant – MedSpa Sales & Front Desk We are looking for a personable and sales-oriented Virtual Assistant to support a MedSpa / Aesthetic & Wellness Practice in Texas offering Botox, fillers, HRT, peptides, and other aesthetic and wellness treatments.
raw.description:
Virtual Assistant – MedSpa Sales & Front Desk

We are looking for a personable and sales-oriented Virtual Assistant to support a MedSpa / Aesthetic & Wellness Practice in Texas offering Botox, fillers, HRT, peptides, and other aesthetic and wellness treatments.

The primary focus of this role is converting leads into appointments, managing patient communication and scheduling, and supporting patient retention. We are looking for someone who is warm and engaging, proactive with follow-ups, confident in sales conversations, and able to create an excellent patient experience without sounding scripted or pushy.

Position Details

  • Position Type: Full-Time
  • Work Days: Monday–Friday
  • Work Hours: 10:00 AM–7:00 PM CST or 11:00 AM–8:00 PM CST, as assigned
  • Rate: $5–$6 per hour
  • Workplace: Remote

Responsibilities

Lead Conversion & Appointment Setting

  • Respond promptly to calls, texts, missed calls, website inquiries, and social media leads.
  • Build rapport, understand patient needs, provide approved information on services, pricing, promotions, consultation options and financing, and convert qualified leads into booked appointments.
  • Follow up consistently with new and old leads who do not immediately book and track their outcomes: booked, follow-up, not interested, no response .
  • Identify appropriate opportunities to recommend or upsell additional services without being pushy.
  • Maintain accurate notes about lead conversations and follow-ups

Scheduling, Patient Communication & Coordination

  • Schedule, confirm, reschedule, and send appointment reminders to new and existing patients.
  • Maintain waitlists, contact patients for earlier openings, fill cancellations and open appointment slots, and collect deposits when required.
  • Coordinate weight-loss, wellness, and HRT patients, including follow-up, lab, and HRT pellet appointments; track patients due or overdue for treatments or labs; and confirm lab completion.
  • Send approved questionnaires, medication pickup/shipping reminders, and pre- and post-treatment instructions, and ensure required paperwork is completed.
  • Answer basic non-clinical questions, explain what patients should expect, and provide a warm, high-quality patient experience by phone and text.
  • Explain cancellation/no-show policies and document important patient communications.
  • Promptly escalate medical questions, symptoms, side effects, or other concerns to the provider. Never diagnose, recommend medication, or independently provide medical advice.

Patient Follow-Up & Retention

  • Maintain lists of patients due for repeat services, follow-ups, or labs and conduct consistent outreach to encourage timely rebooking.
  • Follow up with patients after treatments, according to clinic protocol and recommend next appointments.
  • Reactivate patients who have not returned in several months.
  • Follow up with consultation patients who did not book or purchase.
  • Identify appropriate opportunities for complementary or maintenance treatments without being pushy.

Reviews & Referrals

  • Ask satisfied patients for Google reviews and send review links following positive interactions.
  • Track reviews, conduct appropriate follow-ups, explain available referral promotions, and acknowledge patient referrals.

Marketing Support

  • Track which promotions generate bookings.
  • Contact previous patients regarding approved promotions.
  • Help organize before-and-after photos and related consent documentation.
  • Identify frequently asked patient questions and common booking objections to support marketing efforts.
  • Draft occasional content using ChatGPT when needed.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate patient demographics, intake/consent forms, lead trackers, follow-up lists and manage patient charts.
  • Review upcoming schedules and ensure required forms, labs, deposits, medications, and other appointment needs are ready.
  • Assist with medical scribing and SOAP notes for wellness, HRT, and peptide consultations, as needed.
  • Provide a brief end-of-day summary covering leads, follow-ups, scheduling updates, and issues requiring attention.

KPIs: Speed of answering calls and messages, lead-to-appointment conversion rate, missed-call recovery rate, no-show/cancellation rate, number of empty appointment slots filled, patient follow-up completion, reactivation bookings, Google reviews generated, and quality of patient communication.

Requirements

REQUIREMENTS

  • At least 1 year of experience in sales, lead conversion, appointment setting, customer service, or a similar client-facing role.
  • Excellent spoken English with a minimal noticeable accent and a pleasant, professional phone voice.
  • Warm, personable, engaging, and able to build rapport quickly.
  • Strong emotional intelligence, listening, and conversational skills.
  • Sales-oriented and persuasive without sounding aggressive or scripted.
  • Persistent and comfortable with repeated lead and patient follow-ups.
  • Able to handle difficult patients professionally and work independently.
  • Accountable, dependable, and able to take ownership of tasks through completion.
  • Organized, able to work independently, and comfortable handling difficult patients professionally.

Preferred:

  • MedSpa, aesthetics, wellness, or healthcare experience.
  • Familiarity with Botox, fillers, HRT, or peptides.
  • Medical scribing/SOAP note experience.
  • Experience with Jane EMR.

Basic Requirements

  • Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.
  • Must have relevant work experience.
  • Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available to attend video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

raw.excerpt: The Remote Radiologist is responsible for interpreting diagnostic imaging studies from a remote setting using advanced teleradiology technology.
raw.description:
The Remote Radiologist is responsible for interpreting diagnostic imaging studies from a remote setting using advanced teleradiology technology. This role supports nationwide imaging needs with timely and accurate reporting, contributing directly to high-quality patient care without the need for onsite presence. It enables flexibility while maintaining diagnostic excellence and clinical collaboration through virtual platforms.

Job Duties

  • Interpret a high volume of diagnostic studies remotely, including X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, and other modalities.
  • Deliver prompt, accurate, and well-documented reports to referring clinicians across multiple locations.
  • Communicate critical and time-sensitive findings directly with providers via phone or secure messaging systems.
  • Collaborate with technologists and support staff virtually to ensure protocol adherence and image quality.
  • Use advanced PACS, RIS, and cloud-based teleradiology systems to manage and review cases.
  • Participate in quality assurance, peer review, and virtual team meetings.
  • Maintain up-to-date licensure and compliance documentation for multiple states, as required.
  • Adhere to all HIPAA and data security standards while working in a remote environment.

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Account Management, Delivery and Marketing. You bring positive, client-friendly energy. You are confident, professional and easy to work with. You know how to build trust quickly and navigate approvals without friction.

Highly Desirable

  • Commercially aware and relationship-focused.

raw.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Levels (by Codeforces rating, or equivalent olympiad achievement):

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);
  • Experience creating data for LLM code benchmarks or similar RL / evaluation datasets.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $90/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien process for personal injury law firms. We are looking for proactive, results-driven individuals to join our dynamic team.

Zipliens is building a formal sales leadership seat to sit above and manage our Account Executive, Partnerships, and Sales Development functions. This is a foundational sales leadership hire — you'll be the first person to own the full sales motion end-to-end at Zipliens, with real latitude to build the structure, process, and team from the ground up. This is a hands-on, builder's seat, not a purely strategic one.

You will manage the leaders and individual contributors across the sales org, own the end-to-end sales forecast, and newly establish a traditional sales development practice. You will report to the CCO and partner closely with functional leadership peers to align sales, marketing, customer success, lien resolution operations, product, and revenue planning. You’ll lead the department growth strategy with autonomy to hire and restructure roles and reporting lines further as targets and team capacity become clearer.

Requirements

Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership & Team Management

  • Team Management: Manage and coach the Account Executive, Partnerships, and [outbound] Sales Development functions, whether through direct reports or function leads as the team scales.
  • Hiring & Ramp: Hire, onboard, and ramp new sales talent as the team grows, and set individual and team quotas.
  • Sales Development Build-Out: Build a more established, traditional sales development (SDR/BDR) motion focused on outbound prospecting and qualification, distinct from the relationship-management-oriented hybrid roles Zipliens has used in the past, and complementary to inbound/demand gen as facilitated by Marketing.

Revenue Strategy & Forecasting

  • Forecast Ownership: Own the full sales forecast and pipeline health across Account Executive, Partnerships, and Sales Development sourced pipeline.
  • Executive Reporting: Report on revenue attainment, pipeline health, and forecast accuracy to executive leadership.
  • Quota & Territory Planning: Set lead/opportunity routing, quotas, territories, and/or segment coverage (Single Event and Mass Tort) across the sales team.

Sales Process & Systems

  • Playbook Ownership: Own the sales playbook, stage definitions, and forecasting methodology across the full sales organization. Partner with marketing on battlecards, demo collateral and other enablement.
  • CRM & Sales Hub: Own HubSpot Sales Hub process design and data discipline across all sales functions.

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Marketing Partnership: Partner with the Director of Marketing on lead handoff SLAs, account-based marketing alignment, event strategy, and campaign feedback.
  • Customer Success Partnership: Partner with the Chief Customer Officer and Customer Success team on smooth post-sale handoff and expansion signals from existing accounts.
  • Finance Partnership: Partner with Finance on revenue forecasting, quota planning, and compensation design for the sales team.

Talent & Org Development

  • Career Pathing: Define clear career paths across Sales Development, Account Executive, and Partnerships roles.
  • Active Coaching: Coach direct reports on deal strategy, pipeline management, and professional growth. Beyond 1-1’s, dedicated pipeline reviews and call recording/game film analysis are table stakes.

Qualifications:

  • 5-7 years of B2B sales experience, including at least 2 years directly managing a team of quota-carrying sales professionals.
  • Experience managing multiple sales functions (e.g., Account Executives, SDR/BDR, or Partnerships) is a strong plus, though this may be a first step into that broader scope.
  • Background in legal services, legal tech, or another relationship-driven B2B services/SaaS is a plus.
  • Strong forecasting, pipeline management, and CRM discipline (HubSpot or similar).
  • You’re driven to keep your rep’s calendars full, and bring data-driven performance analysis to the leadership table.
  • Comfortable operating cross-functionally with your stakeholders and collaborators.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for team, partner, and customer engagement.

Benefits

Pay Disclosure: The total base salary range for this role is $162,000 - 243,000 annually, with opportunity for a discretionary bonus. Final compensation will be determined based on skills and experience.

Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer-sponsored visa support now or in the future.

Job Description


The Pump Subject Matter Expert (SME) is the technical authority on liquid flow circulation pumps for our coolant distribution unit products, including the design, optimization, deployment, and troubleshooting of pump solutions. They bridge advanced thermal engineering theory with pump manufacturing experience, field execution and lifecycle management. . Engagement will be for near term and future R&D efforts.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Understand the industry landscape and product types, including relative performance, manufacturing methods and relative costs for different design options
  • Apply advanced thermodynamics to validate system heat balances, fluid dynamics, and calculate log mean temperature differences.
  • Determine optimal pumping configuration based on heat transfer analysis to specific pump in alignment with heat exchanger/overall system configuration.
  • Utilize industry-standard software and CFD tools to model thermal performance and pressure drops.
  • Component Mastery: Act as the technical authority on system auxiliaries including pumps, valves, piping hydraulics, and water treatment/filtration systems.
  • Select appropriate materials to prevent corrosion, erosion, and fouling.
  • Collaborate with automation teams to define control logic, alarm thresholds, and fail-safe interlocks within BMS or PLC systems.
  • Lifecycle Management & Troubleshooting
  • Root-Cause Analysis (RCA): Lead investigations into thermal incidents, fluid leaks, or performance degradation to reduce downtime.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership & Compliance
  • Collaborate with engineering, quality, procurement and operations teams to execute program objectives.
  • Review technical proposals, ensure compliance with project requirements, and assist in proposal assessment and vendor qualification.
  • Ensure all designs and operations meet industry standards and stringent safety protocols.

Basic (Required) Requirements

  • Minimum Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, backed by significant hands-on industry experience (higher level degree preferred).
  • Exceptional technical writing and presentation skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical information into actionable engineering solutions.

Remote Appointment Setter / Phone Booker - Recruiting & Scheduling

100% Remote | Work From Home | Flexible Schedule | Training Provided

Turn Conversations Into Opportunities — From Home

Are you confident on the phone, highly organized, and great at connecting with people?

We're expanding our remote recruiting team and looking for motivated, dependable professionals to join us as Remote Appointment Setters / Phone Bookers.

In this role, you'll connect with prospective candidates who have already expressed interest in our career opportunities, help them take the next step, schedule interviews, confirm appointments, and keep our recruiting pipeline moving.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone interested in appointment setting, recruiting, customer service, scheduling, call center work, candidate engagement, or administrative support.

No previous recruiting experience is required — comprehensive training and ongoing support are provided.

✓ 100% Remote / Work From Home
✓ Warm Candidate Leads
✓ No Traditional Cold Calling
✓ Flexible Scheduling
✓ Training & Coaching Provided
✓ Entry-Level Candidates Welcome
✓ Recruiting & Leadership Growth Opportunities

What You'll Do

As a Remote Appointment Setter / Phone Booker, you'll be one of the first points of contact for prospective candidates and play an important role in creating a professional, positive applicant experience.

☎️ Candidate Outreach

  • Make outbound calls to candidates who have already expressed interest in available career opportunities

  • Introduce yourself professionally and confirm candidate interest

  • Answer basic questions regarding the interview and scheduling process

  • Encourage interested candidates to complete the appropriate next step

  • Follow up consistently with candidates who have not yet scheduled

  • Reconnect with candidates who missed an appointment

  • Assist candidates who need to reschedule

  • Maintain professional and friendly communication throughout the process

📅 Appointment Setting & Interview Scheduling

Your primary responsibility is simple: connect with interested candidates and get qualified appointments scheduled.

You'll:

  • Schedule interviews using our online calendar system

  • Confirm interview dates and times

  • Assist candidates with scheduling links when necessary

  • Send or coordinate appointment confirmations and reminders

  • Follow up with candidates before scheduled appointments

  • Help reduce cancellations and missed interviews

  • Reschedule candidates when appropriate

  • Maintain an organized and productive interview calendar

💻 Recruiting & Administrative Support

You'll also help keep our recruiting operation organized by:

  • Maintaining accurate candidate notes

  • Updating applicant records and scheduling status

  • Tracking candidate communication and follow-up

  • Communicating through phone, email, and text when appropriate

  • Using online recruiting and scheduling systems

  • Collaborating with recruiters and hiring managers

  • Helping identify candidates who require additional outreach

  • Keeping the interview pipeline moving efficiently

Warm Leads — No Traditional Cold Calling

This is an outbound phone position, so candidates should be comfortable making calls throughout the workday.

However, you're not randomly calling people who have never heard from us.

You'll primarily connect with warm candidate leads—individuals who have already applied, responded to a recruiting opportunity, or expressed interest in learning more about available positions.

Your job is to help move them through the next steps:

Connect → Engage → Schedule → Confirm → Follow Up

If you're comfortable speaking with people and enjoy turning conversations into scheduled appointments, this could be an excellent fit.

What We're Looking For

You may thrive in this position if you're:

  • Friendly, confident, and professional on the phone

  • Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls

  • An excellent verbal communicator

  • Comfortable speaking with different personalities

  • Organized and detail-oriented

  • Dependable with strong follow-through

  • Able to manage multiple conversations and appointments

  • Self-motivated and productive while working remotely

  • Comfortable working toward appointment and activity goals

  • Able to manage your time effectively

  • Comfortable learning new technology

  • Positive and receptive to coaching

  • Able to work independently while contributing to a team

Consistency matters.

Successful appointment setters understand that results come from daily activity, strong communication, organized follow-up, and persistence.

No Experience? We'll Train You.

Previous recruiting or appointment-setting experience is helpful, but not required.

We provide training in areas such as:

  • Phone communication

  • Candidate outreach

  • Appointment-setting techniques

  • Scheduling procedures

  • Candidate follow-up

  • Handling common questions

  • Interview confirmation strategies

  • Calendar management

  • Recruiting systems

  • Professional email and text communication

  • Candidate relationship management

You'll also receive ongoing coaching and support as you develop your skills.

Experience That Transfers Well

Candidates with experience in any of these areas may transition well into this position:

Appointment Setting • Customer Service • Recruiting • Talent Acquisition • Scheduling • Call Centers • Administrative Support • Reception • Customer Care • Inside Sales • Telemarketing • Lead Generation • Client Relations • Staffing • Healthcare Scheduling • Hospitality • Retail • Sales Support

Entry-level candidates and career changers are encouraged to apply.

We value communication skills, dependability, organization, professionalism, coachability, and work ethic as much as previous experience.

🏠 100% Remote / Work From Home

Work from home while staying connected to a collaborative recruiting team through virtual technology.

Your day may include:

  • Outbound candidate calls

  • Interview scheduling

  • Candidate follow-up

  • Appointment confirmations

  • Email and text communication

  • Recruiting system updates

  • Virtual team meetings

  • Coaching and development

No daily commute — your workspace is at home.

⏰ Flexible Scheduling

Enjoy greater flexibility while maintaining the consistency needed to reach candidates and support recruiting goals.

Because this is a candidate-facing phone position, successful team members maintain a consistent calling schedule, respond promptly to candidates, and follow up reliably.

📚 Comprehensive Training & Ongoing Support

You'll receive onboarding and continued development designed to help you become more effective and confident in the role.

Training may include:

  • Call scripts and conversation frameworks

  • Candidate engagement strategies

  • Appointment-setting techniques

  • Objection handling

  • Follow-up strategies

  • Calendar and scheduling systems

  • Recruiting workflow

  • Candidate management technology

  • Communication best practices

  • Productivity and organization

📈 Career Growth Opportunities

This position can be a strong starting point for individuals interested in developing experience in:

  • Recruiting

  • Talent Acquisition

  • Candidate Engagement

  • Recruiting Coordination

  • Interview Scheduling

  • Human Resources

  • Customer Service

  • Training & Development

  • Team Leadership

  • Recruiting Management

Growth opportunities are based on performance, consistency, professionalism, leadership potential, and business needs.

Minimum Requirements

Applicants must:

  • Be at least 18 years of age

  • Be legally authorized to work in the United States

  • Be physically located within the United States

  • Have access to a reliable computer or laptop

  • Maintain reliable high-speed internet

  • Have a reliable phone or headset setup

  • Maintain a quiet, professional workspace for outbound calls

  • Be comfortable making a high volume of phone calls

  • Be comfortable using Zoom and online calendar systems

  • Be comfortable communicating through phone, email, and text

  • Have basic computer skills and the ability to learn web-based recruiting technology

Why This Role Matters

Every candidate interaction creates an opportunity to make a strong first impression.

For many applicants, you'll be the first person they speak with.

Your professionalism, energy, communication, and follow-up can determine whether an interested candidate takes the next step.

Every appointment you schedule helps:

Connect a candidate with an opportunity.

Keep the recruiting pipeline moving.

Support the hiring team.

Create a positive candidate experience.

Ready to Get Started?

If you're motivated, dependable, organized, confident on the phone, and enjoy connecting with people, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply today to be considered for our Remote Appointment Setter / Phone Booker opportunity.

Connect Candidates. Book Interviews. Create Opportunities. Build Your Career From Home. 🚀

raw.description:
About NOCD

NOCD is an award-winning digital health company focused on identifying people with obsessive-

compulsive disorder (OCD) and managing them using evidence-based treatment. OCD affects over 181

million people globally and is ranked by the World Health Organization as one of the top 10 most

disabling conditions. Despite this, over 90% of people with OCD are unable to access effective care due

to stigma and misdiagnosis—earning it the nickname “the secret illness.”

NOCD is solving this global problem by identifying OCD patients online and managing them using our

evidence-based OCD treatment platform. Members can access licensed mental health professionals with

specialized training in OCD, receive video-based tele-therapy, and engage with tech-enabled tools and

moderated communities for continuous support.

Today, NOCD manages the largest community of OCD patients in the world—and we’re just getting

started

About The Role

The Vice President of Accounting will be a key financial leader at NOCD, responsible for building and scaling the accounting infrastructure of a rapidly growing virtual healthcare organization with 1,400+ employees and 50%+ annual growth. This leader will oversee all accounting operations, strengthen and automate financial processes, improve close timelines, ensure accurate GAAP reporting and compliance, and optimize Sage Intacct and other financial systems. The VP will also lead revenue recognition, internal controls, audits, tax and compliance activities, cash management, and the development of a high-performing accounting team, while partnering closely with the CFO, executive leadership, Board, and other stakeholders to build the financial foundation needed to support NOCD's continued growth.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a highly quantitative field.
  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license.
  • 15+ years of progressive accounting leadership experience.
  • At least 7+ years of experience operating as a Controller or Vice President within a high-growth

organization.

  • Proven experience operating within an organization of 1,000+ employees experiencing rapid

growth.

  • Experience supporting or participating in major capital events, including private equity and debt

financing rounds.

  • Expert-level knowledge of U.S. GAAP, including ASC 606 (Revenue from Contracts with

Customers) and ASC 842 (Leases).

Preferred

  • Master’s degree in accounting or an MBA.
  • Public accounting experience, particularly with a Big Four or next-tier accounting firm.
  • Experience leading accounting systems transformation, ERP optimization, and process

automation within a high-growth environment.

Why Work with NOCD

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. With an inclusive culture

and ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

At NOCD, you will:

  • Help scale one of the fastest-growing specialty behavioral health organizations in the world.
  • Work directly with operational, clinical, product, and business leaders to solve meaningful

challenges at scale.

  • Use data, technology, and critical thinking to drive measurable improvements in member

outcomes and business performance.

  • Contribute to a mission that helps people reclaim their lives from one of the world's most disabling

mental health conditions.

  • Build your career in a high-growth environment where ownership, innovation, and execution are

valued and rewarded.

  • Play a role in shaping the future of Noto as we expand beyond OCD into additional behavioral

health specialties.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what

they do, NOCD is the place for you.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, and 401(k) match

● PTO based on an accrual system

  • Casual and engaging startup environment with an outstanding mission-driven team atmosphere
  • NOCD provides 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for the primary caregiver, and 6 weeks of

fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver, for qualifying full-time employees.

Pay Transparency

The expected pay range for this position is $190,000 to $225,000. Actual pay will be based on the individual’s qualifications and experience. This role is also eligible for annual performance-based incentives tied to individual achievement and company-wide goals.

Join a National Top Workplace

Named a Top Workplace in the USA and Top Remote Workplace, Kobie is where the best minds in loyalty come together, driven by passion and innovation. We’re always looking for talented individuals who are ready to join a collaborative, growth-focused culture. As a partner to some of the world’s most recognized brands, we are leaders in loyalty, helping brands build lasting emotional connections with their consumers.

Join Us from Anywhere

While our headquarters are nestled in sunny St. Petersburg, Florida, Kobie embraces a flexible work environment, offering teammates the freedom to work remotely. We understand the importance of work-life balance and support our team with:
·Flexible Time Off to recharge when needed
·Nine Company-Wide Holidays
·A diverse suite of benefits prioritizing your growth, development, and personal well-being
Discover more about our perks and benefits here.
Kobie is a values-led organization where we believe that everyone is a leader, regardless of their position or role.
Travel Requirements:
As a remote-first organization headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, Kobie values meaningful in-person connection and collaboration that strengthens our teams, supports our clients, and enhances our culture. While travel requirements vary by role, periodic travel may be required to support business objectives, team collaboration, customer engagements, training, and company events. Candidates should be able and willing to travel as needed to fulfill the responsibilities of the role.

About the team and what we’ll build together

The Sr. Manager, Org Enablement & Communication is a strategic leader reporting to the AVP, Marketing. This role is the architect of organizational change and cultural adoption across Kobie. You will identify and shepherd major organizational initiatives, from strategic pivots and new capabilities to global expansion, ensuring they're embedded into how we work, communicated with clarity, and realized with intention. Working closely with ELT and cross-functional leaders, you'll move beyond communications to true change enablement, helping teams adopt new ways of working, embedding new capabilities into our culture, and ensuring Kobie evolves intentionally, not by accident. This is a new role at Kobie, and you'll have significant latitude in shaping it. You'll assess what's currently in place, identify gaps and opportunities, and establish the enablement and communications infrastructure that positions Kobie for intentional growth.

How you will make an impact

Organizational Change & Enablement

You will be the architect of organizational change and cultural adoption across Kobie.

  • Work with Leaders to identify emerging organizational initiatives that require thoughtful enablement and cultural adoption, whether that's new team structures, global expansion, or company-wide capability building.
  • Work with the President, ELT and relevant function heads to develop a comprehensive change and enablement strategy.
  • Manage change momentum through to adoption, closing loops, measuring impact, and adjusting as needed.
  • Develop communications that explain not just what is changing, but why it matters to the company, to teams, and to individuals.

Strategic Communications & Organizational Clarity

You will translate executive vision into clear, cascading communications that drive organizational alignment.

  • Partner with the President and ELT on all major announcements—organizational shifts, strategic priorities, new initiatives—to ensure consistency, timing, and impact across the organization.
  • Work with leadership to translate strategy into clear, compelling language that cascades effectively.
  • Develop and oversee our internal communication cadence (all-hands, newsletters, leadership updates) with strategic intentionality, ensuring every touchpoint reinforces organizational priorities and clarity.
  • Support the development of onboarding materials and organizational reference materials that help new and existing teammates understand "how Kobie works" and our values.

Culture & Engagement Strategy

You will set the cultural vision in partnership with leadership and listen deeply to close the gaps between organizational intention and lived experience.

  • Use listening mechanisms—pulse checks, feedback surveys, office hours—to maintain visibility into our culture and identify areas where we can strengthen employee experience.
  • Identify gaps between organizational intention and lived experience, and develop strategies to close them with partnership with leadership.
  • Set the vision for how we foster belonging across all levels and locations.
  • Partner with and amplify the work of employee committees—DE&I, Wellness, and affinity groups—ensuring they have strategic backing, visibility, and resources to drive meaningful cultural outcomes.

Cross-Functional Enablement & Partnerships

You will be a strategic connector, helping leaders across functions understand how their initiatives fit into the bigger organizational picture.

  • Work with HR on employee experience strategy, benefits communication, and organizational listening.
  • Partner with Recruiting on employer brand strategy and candidate experience alignment.
  • Support stakeholders on launching new capabilities or messaging globally, with an eye to why it matters to teammates and implications for how they work.
  • Maintain strategic alignment with marketing leadership on brand consistency and ensuring organizational culture reinforces market positioning.

What you need to be successful

  • 7+ years of experience in organizational development, change management, or internal communications
  • Demonstrated experience leading organizational change or capability-building initiatives
  • Experience working cross-functionally with ELT and function leaders on strategic initiatives
  • Strong writing and communication skills; ability to craft messaging for multiple audiences
  • Bachelor's degree in organizational development, marketing, change management, communications, HR, business, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Who You Are

  • Strategic thinker who sees 2-3 steps ahead—you naturally ask the right questions to prioritize and anticipate impact
  • Change management savvy. You understand organizational psychology, resistance, and how to create conditions for adoption
  • Strong communicator who can distill complexity into clarity for diverse audiences
  • Project continuity mindset—you see things through to completion, not just launch
  • Data-minded: comfortable using surveys, feedback mechanisms, and metrics to inform strategy
  • Natural connector who builds credibility and partnerships across all organizational levels—from ELT to individual contributors
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and ambition—you thrive in a fast-moving, values-driven organization
Who we are As a trusted partner, Kobie delivers market-leading, end-to-end loyalty solutions designed to enable customer experiences for the world's most successful brands. We do this with a strategy-led technology approach that uncovers the truth behind what drives consumers on an emotional level. We believe that our team's passion and expertise are the driving forces behind our success and are proud to be named a Top Workplaces in the USA, where the best and brightest in loyalty drive our mission of growing enterprise value through loyalty.
A place for all We celebrate and embrace diversity at Kobie!
Employment at Kobie is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications, which are directly related to professional competence.
