Job Posting Description

Why join Safeguard Global?

We want to help you “Work in Any Way” - that makes time for family, commitments, and life outside, so that you can have the best of both worlds. When you own what you do and are driven to deliver, you have the flexibility to decide where and how you work.

Our roles aren’t just remote and hybrid first—they break free from the traditional ways of doing things, paving a way for A Job That Works for You.

The role in a nutshell:

The key responsibilities of the Payroll Coordinator will include managing the life cycle of workers employment with Safeguard Global. Key priorities for this position include day to day query management, ensure smooth, efficient and compliant payroll processing for our clients working closely with internal/external providers, generation of sales invoices and ensuring timely and accurate worker payments.

How you will make a difference:

  • Manage end to end payroll cycle for Safeguard Global’s workers payroll post onboard.

  • Maintain high knowledge on all of the company's payroll policies and governmental regulations impacting payroll preparation

  • This role will be focusing on processing payroll for workers.

  • Investigate and correct payroll reports identifying out of balance payroll, Ensure accurate and timely processing of payroll payment to workers

  • Perform necessary review and approve payroll reports against housed information and client input

  • Maintain on periodic basis KPI ,internal reporting ,payroll schedule and master payroll input

  • Working with clients to obtain/relay expert in-country requirements during workers life cycle

  • Monitor and maintain employee data , Ensure all employee records are up to date before the payroll processing

  • Point of contact for workers queries

  • Manage the funding/billing process for payroll completing charging sheet and generating sales invoices

  • Maintain and store all relevant worker documentation through the life cycle of employment as per in country compliance and record keeping guidelines

  • Manage any changes in employment contracts, changes after initial onboard such as salary changes or benefits provided

  • Ensure timely responses to queries received from workers, internal support teams, ICP/ICE and clients

  • Work through compliant offboards for all workers whether on Indefinite or Fixed Term Contracts, this could be voluntary terminations or involuntary

  • Ensure background checks are completed as requested if not finalised prior to first payroll through Implementation.

What will give you an advantage:

  • Two to three years of working experience

  • Established knowledge of payroll concepts , local payroll legislation for supported countries.

  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in local language and English

  • Ability to problem solve, strong attention to detail /analytical skill – Should be able Identify, Resolve and Mitigate issues

  • Ability to multi-task and prioritise workload.

  • Self-directed individual with initiative.

  • Good attention to detail and excellent organisation skill

Who we are and what we do:

Safeguard Global is….Global! With offices worldwide, we help 1500+ companies hire, manage, and pay employees in 170+ countries. It's all about people! Join us to meet diverse folks, explore new cultures, and connect with amazing folks from around the globe.

Our Global Benefits 

  • Autonomy & Flexibility (Work in Any Way): Be supported with as much flexibility as possible.  

  • Bonding Leave: Enjoy paid leave to bond with your new family member.  

  • 2 Charitable Days: Contribute to causes you believe in.  

  • Reward & Recognition Program: Be rewarded for your success and championing our values.  

  • Corporate bonus/SIP: All Guardians are eligible for our annual bonus scheme or sales incentive plan. 

Why become a Guardian: 

  • International Environment: Grow your network internationally and collaborate across the world. Interact, discover cultures, and tap into local expertise.  

  • Our Culture: We emphasize the people factor in everything we do. Our nurturing culture ensures your ideas reach our leaders and your contributions get the recognition they deserve.

  • Learning: We support your continuous growth by providing access to 2 learning platforms, where you can learn at your own pace. 

Next Steps: 

To apply, please click on the following link. We wish you the best with your application. Our Guardian promise to you is to keep in touch to arrange the next stage should your application meet the position's requirements, and or a gentle update if you have been unsuccessful at this time. 

Welcome to the Future of Work!

At Safeguard Global, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and Guardians.

M3 Global Research, an M3 company is looking for a Senior QA Engineer to manage the daily QA activity related to work submitted by the Engineering Team. The Senior QA Engineer will be responsible for testing products to ensure that the software runs smoothly and meets client needs both in functionality and scale.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Including, but not limited to the following:

  • Develops, implements, and manages processes to ensure that products meet required specifications for quality, function, and reliability prior to delivery.
  • Communicates quality standards and parameters to QA team and development team.
  • Coordinates product testing processes.
  • Identifies and analyzes issues, bugs, defects, and other problems, particularly when problems recur in multiple products; recommends and facilitates solutions to these issues.
  • Reviews client, customer, and user feedback.
  • Works with manager to help communicate releases to the business
  • Bachelor's degree and/or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent and/or related work experience
  • 4+ years of relevant QA/testing automation experience
  • Experience with business software systems and user management
  • Knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools and processes
  • Teamwork oriented
  • Exceptional ability to multi-task and balance multiple projects and priorities
  • Ingenuity and the willingness to learn new techniques.
  • Superior problem-solving ability; an analytical mindset
  • Excellent interpersonal communication skills – both verbal and written

AI and Automation Expectations:

Including, but not limited to the following:

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted testing tools and workflows, including how to leverage LLMs to generate test cases, analyze logs, and identify edge cases
  • Experience with test automation frameworks such as Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, and Cypress for end-to-end browser-based testing
  • Working knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or comparable frameworks for validating service-layer behavior
  • Familiarity with AI-powered QA platforms such as Testim, Mabl, or Functionize that use ML to create and maintain automated tests
  • Understanding of CI/CD integration for automated test pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or CircleCI
  • Ability to evaluate and adopt emerging AI tools that improve test coverage, reduce manual effort, and shorten feedback cycles
  • Comfort working alongside AI-generated code and validating its correctness through structured test strategies
  • Awareness of responsible AI usage in testing, including prompt engineering basics and understanding model limitations

Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Position Summary:

The Manager, Lead Operations will serve as the operational owner and subject matter expert for the end-to-end lead management ecosystem, from lead acquisition and capture through enrichment, qualification, scoring, routing, sales handoff, disposition, and recycling.

This person will be accountable for the health, accuracy, governance, and performance of lead flow across Marketing and Sales, including the organization's lead scoring and qualification models. The role will establish the business rules, operational controls, and measurement framework that determine how leads enter, progress through, and exit the lead lifecycle.

This role combines marketing and revenue operations expertise, technical fluency, analytical problem-solving, cross-functional leadership, and people management. The ideal candidate can translate business needs into scalable operational solutions, partner effectively with Sales, Data Science, IT, Analytics, and Operations teams, identify and resolve breakdowns in lead flow, and lead a small team responsible for dependable, high-quality execution.

Essential Job Responsibilities:

  • Own the end-to-end lead lifecycle from capture and enrichment through qualification, scoring, routing, sales handoff, disposition, and recycling.

  • Establish and govern lead lifecycle definitions, qualification criteria, routing and assignment rules, SLAs, disposition processes, and other lead management standards.

  • Monitor lead flow health and proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks, routing issues, data quality problems, lead leakage, processing delays, and other operational gaps.

  • Continuously optimize lead workflows, integrations, business rules, and controls to improve reliability, speed, scalability, and conversion.

  • Partner with Sales Operations and Sales leadership to strengthen lead acceptance, follow-up, disposition, recycling, and closed-loop feedback between Marketing and Sales.

  • Serve as the business and operational owner of lead scoring and qualification models, ensuring they reflect go-to-market priorities, buyer behavior, and sales feedback.

  • Partner with Data Science and Analytics to evaluate model performance, recommend enhancements, validate changes, and manage testing and rollout.

  • Establish governance for scoring and qualification changes, including requirements, impact assessment, testing, documentation, and post-launch validation.

  • Define and monitor lead flow and funnel KPIs, connecting operational performance and lead quality to downstream outcomes such as sales acceptance, opportunity creation, pipeline, and conversion.

  • Use performance data and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities to improve scoring, qualification, routing, and overall funnel effectiveness.

Additional Job Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a key partner across Marketing, Sales Operations, Data Science, IT, Analytics, and other teams for lead flow, scoring, and qualification initiatives.

  • Translate business needs into clear requirements for automation, integrations, data, reporting, and system enhancements.

  • Lead root-cause analysis and cross-functional resolution of complex lead flow issues and coordinate testing and release readiness for changes affecting the lead lifecycle.

  • Evaluate upstream and downstream impacts of changes to protect data quality, reporting integrity, compliance, scalability, and business continuity.

  • Manage, coach, and develop a small team responsible for lead operations, campaign operations, data quality, or related functions.

  • Establish clear priorities, ownership, operating processes, documentation, and escalation paths for business-critical lead operations.

  • Manage the lead operations backlog and intake process, balancing production issues, optimization opportunities, technical debt, and strategic enhancements based on business impact and team capacity.

  • Build a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and proactive problem-solving while providing leadership with visibility into lead flow performance, risks, and priorities.

Expected Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Demand Generation Operations, or a related discipline.

  • 1+ years of people management experience or demonstrated experience leading, coaching, and developing others.

  • Demonstrated experience owning or playing a significant leadership role in a complex lead management ecosystem.

  • Experience managing lead processes including lead capture, enrichment, qualification, scoring, routing, assignment, sales handoff, disposition, and recycling.

  • Experience defining or managing lead lifecycle stages, qualification criteria, routing rules, SLAs, and operational governance.

  • Strong understanding of CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Salesforce, Marketo, HubSpot, Eloqua, Account Engagement, or similar technologies.

  • Experience working with lead scoring models, including behavioral and demographic scoring, predictive scoring, or machine learning-informed models.

  • Experience with lead-to-revenue reporting and funnel performance analysis, including the use of downstream outcomes to evaluate lead quality and operational effectiveness.

  • Ability to understand and discuss technical concepts including data flows, integrations, fields, business logic, APIs, data quality, and system dependencies.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex operational issues using data and translate findings into practical improvements.

  • Excellent communication and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to translate effectively between business stakeholders and technical teams.

  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities and drive work through complex cross-functional organizations.

  • Experience partnering directly with Data Science, Data Engineering, IT, Analytics, or Business Intelligence teams.

  • Familiarity with SQL, BI/reporting tools, data visualization, data warehouses, or modern marketing and revenue data architectures.

  • Experience supporting B2B demand generation and complex or multi-segment sales motions.

  • Experience with account-based marketing, account-level qualification, intent data, propensity models, or buying-group approaches.

  • Experience managing lead routing across multiple territories, segments, products, or sales teams.

  • Knowledge of data privacy, consent management, and marketing data governance.

Expected Compensation

$97,000 - $165,000

The base salary range shown reflects the full range for this role from minimum to maximum. At athenahealth, base pay depends on multiple factors, including job-related experience, relevant knowledge and skills, how your qualifications compare to others in similar roles, and geographical market rates. Base pay is only one part of our competitive Total Rewards package - depending on role eligibility, we offer both short and long-term incentives by way of an annual discretionary bonus plan, variable compensation plan, and equity plans.

Our vision:In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Our company culture:Our talented  employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.

Our DEI commitment:Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.

What we can do for you:

Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative  workspaces  — some offices even welcome dogs.

We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment, full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth enables employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.

In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.

Learn more about our culture and benefits here: athenahealth.com/careers

About Redwood Materials

Redwood is localizing a global battery supply chain that seamlessly integrates recovery, reuse, and recycling — keeping critical minerals in circulation and driving the energy transition. Founded in 2017, we’re delivering low-cost and large-scale energy storage and producing battery materials in the U.S. for the first time, all from batteries we already have.

Business Development Manager – Consumer Technology

We are seeking a Business Development Manager – Consumer Technology, to join the team at Redwood. In this position, you will be responsible for managing relationships with consumer technology and device companies and establishing partnerships to source and recycle lithium-ion batteries. This role is vital to our overall mission and is a key driving force to meeting our company goals in accelerating the production of local, sustainable battery materials and ensuring that end-of-life batteries and materials are collected and processed safely. This position will include strategic account planning, account development, relationship management, and sales management across consumer technology partnerships. You will also serve as the commercial point person for Redwood’s Battery Bin program, a consumer-facing collection initiative that places battery drop-off bins at high-traffic community locations. You’ll work with business and technical teams across Redwood, collaborating to solve business problems with multiple stakeholders. The person who takes on this challenge, if successful, will be instrumental in paving the way for how this industry is shaped and the future of sourcing at Redwood.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Build, foster and maintain relationships with consumer technology companies and device manufacturers to coordinate multi-level partnerships for the collection and recycling of lithium-ion battery materials. Align multiple locations and global stakeholders when necessary.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for consumer technology partnership, managing end-to-end account relationships from initial engagement through long-term partnership execution. Understand each partner’s product lifecycle, sustainability commitments, and battery disposal needs to position Redwood as their preferred recycling partner.
  • Manage the product qualification process with customers, understanding the technical requirements for consumer device battery recycling, and communicate with key stakeholders internally and externally to manage qualification timelines and customers’ expectations.
  • Accountable for making sure the business is on track – ensuring a strong mix of consumer technology partnerships, that we’re exceeding customer expectations, and that battery material is procured profitably considering sourcing cost, operating costs, and logistics cost to feed the machine that is producing the most sustainable battery materials in the world.
  • Recognize customers’ product roadmaps and sustainability programs in detail, aligning our resources to the right programs and priorities, as well as identifying future growth opportunities in the consumer electronics battery sourcing space.
  • Understand customers’ value chain and the influences of each player in the ecosystem. Direct global resources to manage the value chain appropriately as well as negotiate the various contracts (volume, prices, all other T&Cs) with customers.
  • Own business development and operational oversight for Redwood’s Battery Bin program, including partner pipeline development, outreach, proposals, contracting, and expansion planning.
  • Identify, prioritize, and develop relationships with Battery Bin host partners, including retailers, municipalities, universities, nonprofits, and public agencies. Evaluate deployment opportunities and lead the end-to-end launch process from partner qualification through go-live and ongoing account management.
  • Develop partnership models and partner-facing materials for Battery Bin deployments, including grant-funded, leased, sponsored, or paid service structures, as well as pitch decks, implementation guides, FAQs, and related collateral.
  • Track and report performance across consumer device partnerships and Battery Bin sites, using data to improve partner targeting, operational efficiency, cost-to-serve, and overall program economics.
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with engineering, operations, logistics, legal, policy, communications, and compliance teams to ensure partnerships and collection programs are compliant, high impact, and operationally sustainable.
  • Ability to travel 25% when necessary for meetings, tours, site visits, and program launches.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, sustainability, engineering or related fields. Technical background a plus.
  • Sales/business/technical sales experience more than 10 years.
  • Consumer electronics or lithium-ion battery industry experience is strongly preferred. Direct experience working with or at companies that manufacture, assemble, sell, or repair consumer devices.
  • Deep understanding of consumer technology product lifecycles, sustainability initiatives, and circular economy programs within the consumer electronics industry.
  • Experience building and scaling partner programs, channel programs, or distributed collection and deployment networks.
  • Fluent in English for global communication to lead the account management.
  • Strong leadership skills with logical communication.
  • People skills to develop good relationships with customers even when in difficult to navigate situations.
  • Data-driven mindset with experience tracking program KPIs and using performance data to inform strategy and improve operations.
  • Smart, scrappy, entrepreneurial, science-loving, having a bias for action and a lot of grit.
  • An ability to have fun while tackling hard problems!
  • A passion for sustainability and making the world a better place!

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. If you have additional privacy-related questions, please contact us at .

raw.description:
We're growing our Data Science team to ship production machine learning that powers ActivTrak's next generation of workforce intelligence products. This is a hands-on role built around production ownership: you take a problem from formulation through a shipped, monitored model, not just to a notebook.

You'll work on problems like:

  • Predicting user roles and classifying activity from behavioral event data
  • Cross-account benchmarking that turns aggregate usage patterns into product-differentiating insight
  • Making pragmatic tradeoffs between model sophistication, business value, reliability, latency/cost, and iteration speed
  • Partnering with our Data Engineers, who take your models and analysis and turn them into durable, scalable production systems

Where this role starts and ends: You own problem formulation, feature definition, model and scoring logic, evaluation, and ongoing model performance in production. Data Engineering owns the pipeline infrastructure, orchestration, deployment mechanisms, and operational reliability that put your work into production. The primary ownership is clear, but you'll work together across that boundary when production issues span model and platform — your job is the model delivering the intended outcome and improving over time.

This is an individual-contributor role with substantial ownership over your problem space. It does not include people-management responsibilities.

Requirements

Must-Haves:

  • 5+ years bringing machine learning to production at scale, with direct experience making the sophistication/speed/reliability tradeoffs described above
  • Strong Python and production-grade software engineering practices (testing, code review, version control)
  • Experience with classification/prediction problems on behavioral, event, or user activity data
  • Strong SQL and comfort working directly against production data sources, not just flat files or CSVs
  • Experience with feature engineering: defining, standardizing, and validating features for production models
  • Experience monitoring model quality after deployment and responding to drift or degradation, not just shipping and moving on

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Time series analysis and/or hidden state models
  • Parallel dataframes (Dask, Spark, or similar)
  • Comfort working within a layered/medallion-style data architecture (raw → cleansed/identified → aggregated/de-identified)
  • Feature store experience (versioning, storage, reuse)
  • Cloud environment experience (GCP or AWS), and general comfort operating around containerized/orchestrated infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes) even if you're not the one building it

Benefits

Why Should You Apply?

  • Own production ML that reaches customers and improves through real-world feedback
  • Work on a genuinely uncommon ML problem: behavioral event data from 9,500+ customer organizations, used for role prediction, activity classification, and cross-account benchmarking
  • Small, senior team with real ownership and visibility to leadership

Work environment

  • Position is remote within US
  • Minimal travel
  • Limited physical demands

This is an incredible opportunity to embark on an exciting journey with a dynamic, VC-backed company. If you have a proven track record of creative thinking, a drive for learning, and a deep commitment to collaboration, we want to talk to you!

Instinct Science is at the forefront of veterinary innovation, comprised of world-class tools that have served our industry for decades: easy-to-use veterinary practice software (Instinct EMR), an essential resource for expanding your knowledge and skills (Clinician's Brief), clinical and pharmaceutical decision support (Standards of Care & Plumb's), and an AI scribing platform (ScribbleVet). Combined, Instinct Science offers an ecosystem that veterinarians rely on for every aspect and stage of their careers.

At Instinct Science, we believe in leading with compassion. Our team, our customers, and their patients and clients are the foundation of everything we do. Our culture is guided by our U.C.A.R.E. values: We move fast because our mission matters, we put customers at the center of every decision, and we treat each other with kindness and high standards.

A Sneak Peek of Your Role 🔭

This is a fully remote role.

The Customer Training Specialist is a cross-trained product expert who delivers hands-on training and enablement support across Instinct's full product suite — to both onboarding and active customers. You are part of a tightly coordinated team that operates as a single unit: shared ticketing, round-robin assignments, and a commitment to delivering a fluid, consistent experience regardless of which specialist shows up.

You do not own a single account or project. You are deployed where training is needed — whether that is a new hospital moving through onboarding, an active customer navigating a contact change, a team getting oriented to a newly released feature, or a post-upsell product tour. This flexibility is your strength, and you are expected to be fully interchangeable with your teammates.

You leverage Glyphic, HubSpot, and Claude to reference account history, preferences, and project context so every interaction feels informed and personal — even when you are stepping in without prior direct relationship. You are expected to travel frequently, and you build your work in a way that ensures your absence never disrupts the team.

What You'll Do 🛠️

Training Delivery

  • Onboarding Training: Deliver product training to hospital teams at key milestones during the onboarding process — coordinating with the Onboarding Manager to ensure timing supports go-live readiness.
  • Active Customer Training: Support active customers navigating contact changes, new feature releases, post-upsell product tours, or areas of low adoption identified through the CS or Enablement team.
  • Cross-Product Fluency: Maintain current, confident training capability across Instinct's full product suite — keeping pace with releases and updates as they ship.
  • Flexible Deployment: Operate as a shared resource across the team — picking up new training assignments from the shared queue, adapting quickly to new accounts, and delivering consistent quality without needing extended ramp time.

Account Intelligence & Preparation

  • Pre-Session Research: Before each engagement, use Glyphic, HubSpot, and Claude to review relevant account notes, workflow preferences, prior training history, and any context that allows you to show up informed.
  • Contextual Delivery: Tailor each training session to the specific hospital — referencing their workflows, product configuration, and team dynamics rather than delivering a generic walkthrough.
  • Session Documentation: Log training outcomes, follow-up items, and customer feedback in HubSpot and Glyphic after each engagement, ensuring teammates and account owners have full visibility.

Team Coordination & Travel

  • Shared Team Model: Operate within the team's shared ticketing and assignment system — taking on new work, communicating capacity, and maintaining coverage standards that keep SLAs intact.
  • Travel: Travel frequently to deliver on-site training — building relationships with hospital teams and delivering sessions in-person where context and environment make it more effective.
  • Continuity: Structure your ongoing work so that any teammate can step in during travel without disruption — documenting, communicating, and organizing to support team continuity.
  • Feedback Loop: Bring patterns, product gaps, and customer feedback back to the Training and Enablement Director and Enablement team to inform content development and product roadmap conversations.

Who You Are 🐱‍💻

Must Haves:

  • Veterinary Practice Experience: Required. You have worked in a veterinary hospital and understand how clinical teams operate, communicate, and adopt new tools.
  • Instinct Software Experience: Strongly preferred. Prior experience using or training on Instinct products significantly accelerates your effectiveness.
  • Customer-Facing Training or Education: 1–3 years delivering product training, clinical education, or customer enablement in a fast-paced environment.
  • CRM & Call Intelligence Tools: Comfortable working in HubSpot and using call intelligence tools (e.g., Glyphic) to prep for and document customer sessions.
  • Travel Availability: Able and willing to travel frequently — typically multiple trips per month — without disruption to team operations.

How Instinct will Care about YOU 🌞

  • We offer a supportive and caring work environment.
  • We are transparent, open, honest, and empathic, both internally and externally.
  • We pay our team well.
  • We offer medical, dental and vision benefits and 401K with match.
  • We give our team owner-like flexibility over work and time-off, including time to innovate and Flow State Fridays.
  • We offer a generous stipend that can be used for almost anything to allow you to bring your best self to work.
  • We provide all-expense-paid time throughout the year together, including at our annual retreat.

The compensation range for this role is $55,000 - $70,000. Actual compensation will be determined through a variety of factors including the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

Instinct is an equal opportunity employer committed to equality and providing a pleasant work environment free from harassment or discrimination in any form. All employees will be treated equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, ancestry, veteran, or disability status.

If you require accommodations throughout any part of the pre-employment process, please contact our recruiting team at

Description/Responsibilities

Our VP, Digital Marketing & Analytics is a growth and performance-driven leader responsible for building and expanding a modern, data-driven digital marketing ecosystem that generates demand, increases member engagement, and drives conversion rates across member, employer and health plan audiences.

This role will own the end-to-end digital marketing experience with channel optimization across paid media, web, marketing automation and SEO/SEM using analytics to accelerate pipeline growth and support complex member engagement and commercial buying journeys.

As a key member of the marketing leadership team, this role will partner with our marketing strategists, product directors and engineers to grow our digital capabilities and advance go-to-market strategies for B2B2C, B2B and member-facing digital experiences. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in performance marketing, digital experience optimization including AI enablement, marketing technology and marketing analytics along with experience in a highly regulated HIPAA-compliant environment.

Key Responsibilities:

Digital Strategy & Channel Leadership

  • Define and execute a comprehensive digital marketing strategy aligned to pipeline and revenue goals
  • Own performance optimization across key channels including paid search, paid social, display, programmatic, retargeting, and organic search
  • Develop channel strategies tailored to member, employer, health plan, and broker/consultant audiences
  • Build a growth engine and operating model that uses AI, personalization, and continuous testing to grow engagement optimized against member and business outcomes

Demand Generation & Funnel Optimization

  • Partner with Growth Operations, Sales and Client Relations to drive qualified pipeline through digital channels
  • Optimize the full digital funnel - from awareness to conversion - using data-driven insights
  • Continuously test and refine targeting, creative, messaging, and user journeys to improve conversion rates

Website & Digital Experience

  • Own the company websites as a primary demand and conversion engine
  • Lead UX/UI strategy, personalization, and conversion rate optimization (CRO)
  • Ensure content is aligned to buyer stages and personas, supporting both acquisition and education

Analytics & Performance Management

  • Establish KPIs and dashboards to measure digital performance, pipeline contribution, and ROI
  • Provide strategic oversight of marketing analytics across B2C, B2B2C, and B2B audiences, ensuring performance data is translated into clear insights, executive-ready reporting, and actionable recommendations that improve campaign effectiveness, channel productivity, audience targeting, member engagement, retention, revenue contribution, and marketing RO
  • Oversee advanced marketing analytics capabilities, including data modeling, attribution, segmentation, experimentation/A-B testing, CRM analytics, and marketing automation analytics, ensuring insights are translated into stronger targeting, measurement, and performance optimization
  • Lead the infusion of AI into digital marketing workflows and ways of working identifying high-impact use cases, piloting and scaling AI-enabled tools and processes
  • Establish a test-and-learn discipline that uses data, experimentation, and performance measurement to continuously optimize marketing campaigns, customer journeys, channel mix, and budget allocation
  • Provide actionable insights to marketing and executive leadership

Content Distribution & SEO

  • Partner with Content & Creative and Product Marketing to amplify thought leadership and campaign assets
  • Own SEO strategy, including technical SEO, keyword strategy, and content optimization
  • Ensure content is effectively distributed across digital channels to maximize reach and engagement

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely across Marketing as well as with Growth Operations, Sales and Client Relations to ensure alignment across campaigns
  • Support account-based marketing (ABM) efforts with targeted digital strategies
  • Collaborate with Client Success on digital engagement and retention initiatives

Team Leadership & Vendor Management

  • Build and lead a high-performing digital marketing team (in-house and agency partners)
  • Manage external vendors and media agencies to ensure performance and efficiency
  • Allocate and optimize digital budget to maximize ROI

Qualifications

Experience

  • 10+ years of digital marketing experience, with at least 3–5 years in a leadership role
  • Proven track record of driving measurable pipeline and revenue through digital channels in B2B2C and B2B environments
  • Experience in healthcare, supplemental benefits, digital health, or related industries strongly preferred

Capabilities

  • Deep expertise in performance marketing, SEO/SEM, paid media, and conversion rate optimization
  • Demonstrated ability to turn marketing data into actionable performance improvements across campaigns, channels, audiences, and customer journeys.
  • Strong understanding of B2B2C and B2B buyer journeys, especially in complex, multi-stakeholder sales environments
  • Data-driven mindset with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with attribution models, funnel metrics, and marketing analytics
  • Ability to translate strategy into execution with speed and precision

Leadership Attributes

  • Player-coach who can operate both strategically and tactically
  • Highly collaborative with strong cross-functional influence
  • Results-oriented with a focus on accountability and continuous improvement
  • Curious, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-evolving environment

Success Metrics Include

  • Digital contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Cost per lead (CPL), cost per acquisition (CPA), and return on ad spend (ROAS)
  • Website conversion rates and engagement metrics
  • Lead quality, scoring accuracy, and funnel velocity
  • Member engagement, subscriptions and retention metrics
  • SEO rankings, organic traffic growth, and share of voice
  • Marketing attribution accuracy and insights

The salary range for this opportunity is $175,000 to $200,000. Compensation depends on several factors: qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience.

Responsabilités et tâches

  • Élaborer et superviser les plans stratégiques de vente et de marketing afin d'atteindre les cibles de vente et les objectifs de revenus de l'entreprise dans le marché ERP.

  • Agir comme principal représentant de l'entreprise et signataire principal dans les cycles de vente auprès de nouveaux clients, en menant personnellement les démarches auprès des prospects, la négociation des ententes et la signature des contrats net new.

  • Mobiliser et inspirer l'équipe de vente répartie, en encadrant directement la ressource dédiée aux ventes auprès de la base installée et la ressource en appui aux ventes net new, tout en participant activement à la conquête de nouvelles parts de marché.

  • Établir les territoires de vente, les quotas et les cibles ambitieuses pour l'équipe.

  • Générer des pistes de vente par tous les canaux pertinents et bâtir personnellement un bassin de prospects net new.

  • Établir et entretenir des relations solides avec les clients clés, les partenaires et les parties prenantes, en agissant comme point d'escalade et conseiller de confiance pour les comptes stratégiques.

  • Analyser les tendances du marché, les activités de la concurrence et les commentaires des clients dans le secteur ERP afin de cerner les occasions de croissance et d'innovation.

  • Préparer et présenter régulièrement des rapports de vente et de marketing, des prévisions et des recommandations à la haute direction.

Exigences

  • Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, en marketing, dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience pertinente équivalente.

  • 5 ans et plus d'expérience en vente de logiciels, idéalement dans le domaine des ERP ou des logiciels d'entreprise.

  • 3 ans et plus d'expérience à la tête d'une équipe de vente.

  • Capacité démontrée à conclure personnellement des ventes net new et à agir comme négociateur et signataire principal dans des cycles de vente complexes.

  • Excellentes habiletés de communication et de présentation.

  • Sens de l'organisation exceptionnel, esprit critique, ténacité et volonté d'accepter des risques de façon appropriée.

  • Flexibilité pour voyager selon les besoins pour des rencontres clients, des événements de l'industrie et des conférences.

Atouts :

  • La connaissance de la solution ERP Acumatica constitue un atout important.

  • La connaissance des solutions ERP Abak et/ou Manitou constitue un atout.

Rémunération

La fourchette salariale potentielle pour ce poste est de 100 000 $ à 130 000 $ par an, en plus d'un plan de commission, et une admissibilité à un programme de primes ou de mérite. La rémunération finale dépendra de l'expérience, des compétences, des conditions du marché et de l'équité interne. Nous offrons un programme de rémunération globale compétitif qui inclut des avantages sociaux, une participation de l'employeur au REER, des options d'achat d'actions et des opportunités de développement de carrière.

Mindrift is looking for a versatile, highly skilled Graphic Designer to join the Tendem project (**) andcreate high-quality visual assets for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in visual communication, layout design, and branding to transform ideas into professional, polished creative assets. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, layout design, and creating diverse marketing materials.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Graphic Designer, your focus will be on layouts, infographics, social media templates, and overall visual polish. We need a versatile, all-around graphic designer to handle diverse visual tasks, utilizing industry-standard tools to structure information cleanly and effectively.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the creation of clean layouts, modern infographics, and establish a clear visual hierarchy to ensure readable and engaging content.
  • Design highly engaging, reusable templates for various social media channels, as well as impactful one-pagers.
  • Elevate everyday materials by working deeply with advanced typography, grid systems, and thoughtful composition.
  • Transform raw data and concepts into professional, polished visual assets tailored to specific marketing and communication goals.
  • Enforce design quality standards through systematic verification of visual alignment, color usage, and layout consistency prior to delivery.

Important note

Please submit your CV in English. Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with examples of your work — applications without a portfolio link will not be considered.

This is project-based freelance work. Tasks are available only when projects are active. You may be invited to one or more projects depending on your profile and current opportunities.

How to get started

Simply apply to this post, complete the qualification process, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills — on your own schedule.

Requirements

Educational qualifications

  • At least 1-2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, digital design, or visual communications is desirable.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or related creative fields is a plus.

Candidates must have a strong, diverse portfolio showcasing a wide variety of formats (such as social media graphics, marketing collateral, and one-pagers). We are looking for versatile specialists with an exceptional grasp of typography, visual composition, and grid systems. An adaptable, fast-paced, and detail-oriented approach is essential, along with the ability to work independently to solve visual challenges.

raw.excerpt: Driftrock is hiring its first Sales Development Representative to build the outbound engine that fills our pipeline with the world's biggest automotive brands.
raw.description:
Driftrock is hiring its first Sales Development Representative to build the outbound engine that fills our pipeline with the world's biggest automotive brands.

Quick facts

  • Team: Commercial
  • Reports to: Commercial Director
  • Location: Remote
  • Contract: Full-time, permanent
  • Salary: £40,000 to £50,000 base, with OTE and share options
  • Start date: As soon as we find the right person

Why this role exists

Driftrock helps the world's biggest automotive and e-mobility brands turn marketing into real vehicle sales. Demand for what we do is growing, and we want a repeatable, predictable way to start conversations with the right people at the right accounts.

This is our first dedicated SDR role, so you will own outbound from the ground up. You will decide how we find and reach target accounts, build the sequences and systems that make it repeatable, and use AI to do the work of a much larger team. The pipeline you create feeds directly into new business, which makes this one of the most visible and valued roles in the company.

What you'll own

You will be accountable for the top of our new-business pipeline: the volume and quality of qualified meetings and opportunities created from both outbound prospecting and inbound leads.

Your first 90 days

  • By day 30: you have mapped our ideal customer profile, our target account list, and the tools and data already in place, and you understand how leads flow through to the sales team today.
  • By day 60: you have launched your first outbound sequences and AI-assisted workflows, and qualified meetings are landing in the calendar.
  • By day 90: you are booking qualified meetings every week from a repeatable, documented playbook, with clear reporting on what is working.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and run outbound end to end, from target account research through to booked meetings, without waiting for a playbook to be handed to you.
  • Qualify and route inbound leads quickly, so genuine buyers reach the sales team while they are still warm.
  • Design multi-channel sequences across email, phone, LinkedIn and video, and iterate on messaging based on what actually converts.
  • Use AI tools for research, list building, enrichment, personalisation and drafting, so you operate with the output of a full team.
  • Research target accounts, including automotive brands, retailers and e-mobility companies, and map the right people to reach within them.
  • Keep the CRM clean and current, so pipeline reporting is something the whole commercial team can trust.
  • Report on outbound performance and share what is working, turning your own experiments into a documented playbook others can build on.

What you'll bring

  • A track record of creating qualified pipeline as an SDR or in a similar outbound role, ideally in B2B software.
  • The independence to own outbound solo, set your own priorities, and get on with the job with light oversight.
  • Strong, credible written and spoken communication that gets busy senior people to reply.
  • Fluency with AI tools for prospecting and outreach, and a habit of finding new ones to work faster and smarter.
  • Comfort with modern sales tooling: CRM, sequencing and prospecting platforms, and lead enrichment.
  • A structured, experiment-driven approach: you measure what you do and improve it week on week.
  • Self-motivation and resilience, and the drive to keep starting conversations even on the quiet days.

Bonus points

  • Experience selling into automotive, mobility or another enterprise B2B market.
  • Experience being the first or only SDR, or otherwise building an outbound function from scratch.
  • Familiarity with marketing technology, lead generation or advertising platforms.

Why Driftrock

Driftrock's mission is to become the world-leading automotive and e-mobility marketing software platform, and help accelerate the transition to clean transport.

We work with some of the world's biggest brands, including BMW, BYD, Mercedes-Benz and Volvo, and partner with the world's leading platforms, including Meta, Google, and Auto Trader.

We've been building since 2013, and our work enables billions of euros in vehicle sales every year.

We're a close, fully remote team of 35 people across engineering, design, customer success, performance and commercial, spread across the world.

That means your work has a real, visible impact on our product, our culture and how we operate.

We're at the cutting edge of marketing technology, with plenty of room to unlock value from data and to help speed up the shift to electric vehicles.

How we work is shaped by four values:

  • We care: about our team, our customers, and the people who see the marketing messages that we power. Work isn't done until we can prove it's useful to both the consumer and the customer.
  • Be that person: if something needs fixing, fix it. It's never someone else's problem.
  • People-first: we put people at the core of everything, and never compromise security or privacy for results.
  • Be better today than you were yesterday: we bake learning and continuous improvement into everything we do, for ourselves and our customers.

In practice, this looks like weekly Monday Showcases where we share what we're learning, regular retros, a budget to attend the courses and conferences that grow you, Donut coffee pairings to stay connected, and an annual company Summit that brings the whole global team together in person.

What's in it for you

We're remote-first and flexible about how and where you work, with co-working space available if you want it. Alongside your salary:

  • Share options in Driftrock, on founder-friendly, tax-efficient EMI terms, including the option to retain vested options after leaving (at board discretion).
  • Comprehensive Vitality health cover: medical, dental, vision, hearing, mental-health support and therapy, cancer cover, a free Headspace subscription and Vitality rewards.
  • 24 to 28 days' holiday (24 + 1 extra each year, capped at 28), plus bank holidays.
  • Pension contributions, life assurance (3x salary) and income protection.
  • Electric car salary-sacrifice scheme (Octopus): save up to ~40%, with insurance, servicing and a charging perk included.
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave.
  • A learning budget for books, courses and conferences, plus time for personal goals.
  • Perks and discounts via CharlieHR, and a BMW Group employee discount programme.

Our hiring process

  1. A short intro call.
  2. A conversation with the hiring manager.
  3. A practical task based on real challenges, never unpaid spec work.
  4. A final conversation with the team.

Inclusion at Driftrock

Driftrock is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background, identity and life experience, and we're building a team that reflects the people our marketing reaches. We don't make decisions based on age, disability, gender, gender identity, marital status, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, or sexual orientation. If you need any adjustments to the application or interview process to do your best, just let us know, and we're glad to help.

Footer

We will not be considering recruitment agencies for this role.

By applying for this job you give us permission to store your data on our secure applicant tracking system and to contact you about Driftrock job opportunities. We process your data for recruitment purposes only and keep it until this role is filled, after which we will delete it or, with your agreement, keep it for similar future roles for up to 12 months. See our privacy policy at for how we comply with GDPR, including how to access, correct, delete or restrict the data we hold. You can lodge a complaint with the UK supervisory authority (the Information Commissioner's Office), or contact our DPO for any concerns.

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and proactive Sales Assistant to support a fast-moving sales team across CRM management, scheduling, follow-ups, proposals, reporting, and day-to-day sales operations.

This is not a direct selling role.

Instead, you’ll help the sales team stay organized, keep pipeline data accurate, coordinate communication, and ensure deals continue moving forward without operational gaps.

You’ll support:

  • CRM management
  • Calendar & meeting coordination
  • Sales follow-ups
  • Proposal preparation
  • Pipeline reporting
  • Cross-functional coordination
  • Day-to-day sales operations

If you’re detail-oriented, proactive, and enjoy keeping systems and people organized, this role is a strong fit.

  • Salesforce
  • HubSpot
  • Zoho CRM
  • Pipedrive

You’ll:

  • Maintain accurate pipeline stages
  • Log activities and notes
  • Remove duplicate records
  • Identify and correct missing information

raw.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

SUMMARY

The Lead Electrical CAD Engineer is a hands-on individual contributor responsible for the development, release and sustainment of electrical schematics, panel layouts, wiring and power distribution designs for mission critical power and cooling products. This role owns electrical design integrity across concept, NPI, production and sustaining phases, ensuring compliance with applicable safety standards, regional regulations and customer requirements.

The position requires deep expertise in electrical CAD tools, strong understanding of industrial power and control systems, and close coordination with mechanical and PLM teams to maintain alignment between electrical designs, physical layouts and released product configurations; while supporting rapid, disciplined engineering change execution.

Job Title: Lead Electrical CAD Engineer

Organization: Data Center Infrastructure Team

Location: Austin, TX - or Remote*

*Requires up to 25% domestic and/or international travel (rare)

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Electrical CAD Design & System Integration

  • Independently develop and maintain electrical schematics, panel layouts, and wiring designs for complex industrial systems using EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical, SolidWorks Electrical and/or Edge Electrical.

  • Design and document power distribution, protection, grounding, and control circuits supporting power distribution and cooling platforms.

  • Ensure electrical designs meet functional performance, safety, reliability and serviceability requirements across operating conditions.

  • Resolve electrical packaging and integration challenges in coordination with mechanical layouts, thermal constraints and enclosure architectures.

Configuration Aware Design & Lifecycle Execution

  • Execute configuration controlled electrical designs supporting multiple product variants, options and regional variations.

  • Maintain stability and traceability of electrical designs as engineering changes are introduced.

  • Implement engineering changes (ECR/ECNs) efficiently while preserving compliance, backward compatibility and production continuity.

  • Ensure accurate synchronization between schematics, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, BOMs and PLM system records throughout the product lifecycle.

Standards, Compliance & Safety

  • Design electrical systems that are compliant with applicable IEC, UL and regional standards, as well as customer specific specifications.

  • Apply sound engineering judgment to ensure electrical safety, fault protection, arc mitigation, grounding and clearance/creepage requirements.

  • Support internal and external compliance activities by providing accurate documentation and responding to design related findings.

Panel Layout, Wiring & Manufacturing Support

  • Develop detailed panel layouts including component placement, wire routing and labeling aligned with mechanical constraints and thermal considerations.

  • Ensure wiring designs are manufacturable, accessible and service-friendly, with clear documentation for production.

  • Support prototype builds, production ramp up and manufacturing issue resolution through direct design updates and clarifications.

Cross Functional Technical Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with mechanical engineering to ensure electrical mechanical fit, clearance, airflow and thermal compatibility.

  • Partner with manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and production teams to address build issues, component substitutions and all feedback.

  • Participate in technical design reviews and release readiness activities as a senior technical contributor.

  • Contribute through execution to the continuous improvement of electrical CAD practices, documentation clarity and configuration discipline.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related engineering discipline.

  • 8+ years of hands-on electrical CAD design experience with industrial or infrastructure class equipment.

  • Strong proficiency in EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical, SolidWorks Electrical and/or Edge Electrical.

  • Demonstrated experience designing power distribution and control systems for complex, multi-variant products.

  • Working knowledge of IEC, UL, and regional electrical compliance requirements.

  • Ability to independently execute and own complex electrical designs with minimal oversight.

Preferred Experience

  • Electrical design experience for power and cooling systems, switchgear, transformers, busway, PDCs, CDUs, chillers, or thermally intensive infrastructure.

  • Experience with switchgear, control panels and industrial power systems.

  • Proven background in panel layout, wire routing and electrical mechanical integration.

  • Familiarity with PLM systems and formal product release and change control processes.

  • Experience supporting both NPI and sustaining engineering in production environments.

Core Competencies

  • Senior level, hands on electrical CAD execution

  • Strong configuration and documentation discipline

  • Deep understanding of electrical safety and compliance

  • Cross domain collaboration with mechanical and thermal engineering

  • High attention to detail under fast paced change conditions

  • Independent technical ownership without managerial responsibility

About the Data Center Infrastructure (DCI) Team:

The DCI team consists of technical subject matter experts who specialize in end-to-end large scale physical infrastructure that powers and enables modern data centers. This includes power distribution systems such as transformers, substations, generators, switchgear, switch panels, busways, ATS units, EDPM, BMS systems, and control panels, as well as cooling solutions ranging from traditional evaporative and indirect cooling systems to emerging liquid cooling technologies including chillers, heat exchangers, CDUs, pumps, and secondary fluid networks. The team also addresses the mechanical structures that house these systems - hot aisle containment, steel enclosures, blanking panels, cable trays, and fiber and networking infrastructure.

The DCI team operates as a cross-industry center of excellence, partnering primarily with various cloud providers across the industry. Team members function as deeply technical subject matter experts who engage directly with customers and supply chain partners to assess requirements, identify challenges, and design infrastructure solutions end-to-end. The ideal contributor brings engineering-level expertise in either power or cooling disciplines, a working knowledge of the full infrastructure dependency chain, and the ability to translate that expertise into clear recommendations and collaborative problem-solving with both technical and business stakeholders.

The pay range for this role is $105,100 - $189,200. TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro, empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk.

At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI-powered future.

AI Fearlessly.

About the Team

Our Security Research & Development group sits at the frontier of AI-era cyber defense. We study how attackers are beginning to weaponize artificial intelligence, how AI is reshaping detection and response, and what durable capabilities defenders will need over the next several years. We are not a day-to-day operations team. Our charter is to research, prototype, and design the core capabilities that will anchor our platform and our customers' defenses for the next generation.

The Role

We are seeking a Principal Threat Architect to research the frontier of AI-era threats and defensive technologies and to design the core detection-and-response capabilities that will anchor our platform for the next several years. This is a senior individual-contributor role at the intersection of threat research and systems architecture.

You will study emerging threats and newly viable technologies, prototype and validate novel defensive approaches, and converge open-ended research into durable, production-grade operational architecture. You will work across disciplines — threat intelligence, detection engineering, AI/ML, and platform engineering — to translate what you learn into foundational capabilities rather than point solutions. Success in this role means the architecture you design today is still the foundation defenders build on years from now.

Key Responsibilities

  • Threat & technology research. Research the evolving AI-era threat landscape — including AI-enabled attacks and threats to AI systems themselves (e.g., prompt injection, model misuse, data leakage) — and translate findings into defensive strategy.

  • Architecture & capability design. Design new threat operational architecture: scalable, robust detection-and-response systems that integrate with existing security tooling, data pipelines, and analyst workflows.

  • Prototyping & experimentation. Envision, build, and validate prototypes that demonstrate the feasibility and impact of novel defensive approaches; converge open-ended research into concrete, supportable specifications.

  • Research-to-production bridge. Partner with detection engineering, data science, and platform teams to transition prototypes from early-stage design into durable, production-grade capabilities.

  • Technical leadership. Provide principal-level technical leadership on core design decisions and trade-offs; set direction that peers and adjacent teams build upon.

  • Communication & influence. Communicate complex research and architectural direction clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership; contribute to thought leadership as appropriate.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8+ years in cybersecurity, with demonstrable depth in threat detection and response.

  • Proven track record designing and delivering complex technical systems from concept through production deployment.

  • Hands-on experience architecting scalable systems that integrate with existing security tooling and operational workflows.

  • Working familiarity with AI/ML concepts and their application to threat detection, prevention, or response, including awareness of AI-specific threats and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Experience in a research, R&D, or emerging-technologies function, with a demonstrated ability to take ambiguous, open-ended problems and converge them into concrete specifications.

  • Proficiency in at least one production programming language (e.g., Python).

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including conveying complex technical concepts to varied audiences.

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's in computer science, machine learning, or a security-related discipline.

  • Direct experience with AI/ML security — securing ML/GenAI models, adversarial ML, or defending against AI-enabled attacks — aligned with frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs.

  • Experience building or operating detection-and-response platforms (EDR / XDR / MDR, SIEM, SOAR) or agentic SOC architectures.

  • Hands-on experience with large-scale data-processing systems and modern distributed architectures.

  • Proficiency in systems languages such as C/C++ or Rust in addition to Python.

  • Familiarity with cloud security across AWS, Azure, or GCP and with hybrid/multi-cloud environments.

  • Publication, patent, or conference-presentation record in threat research or applied AI security.

  • Experience within a vendor CTO office, security research lab, or comparable innovation function.

What We Offer You

You're important to us. What matters to you, matters to us too. TrendAI provides benefit options for you and your family.

  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance

  • Life insurance

  • Short & Long Term Disability

  • Pre-partum, maternity, parental and medical leave

  • Mental Health Wellness Program

  • Adoption Assistance

  • Wellness Incentive

  • Pet Insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid Time Off

  • 14 Annual Holidays

  • Tuition Assistance

  • Employee Resource Groups

We offer competitive compensation with bonus opportunity tied to company performance, along with room to enhance your skills through ongoing learning and broad technological opportunities. Achieving work-life balance is a priority, complemented by team activities, fostering an environment rooted in equity, inclusion, and collaboration, that is reflected in both our culture and our work.

Be Passionate. Be Innovative. Be a Trender.

This position does not offer sponsorship for work permit applications or renewals, either now or in the future. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship, both currently and moving forward. The company will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this role (including, but not limited to, H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT, or any other employment-based visa).

raw.description:
Technical Project Manager – Metronet

POSITION SUMMARY:

We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Project Manager (TPM) to lead and coordinate complex, cross-functional projects within our service provider network environment. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in DWDM, IP/MPLS and PON networks, NOC operations, OSS/NMS/EMS systems, and automation frameworks, along with proven experience in project management methodologies. This role is critical in driving initiatives related to disaster recovery, sparing strategies, root cause analysis, network tools /software development, and operational automation.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Lead end-to-end project delivery for network and systems initiatives, including planning, execution, risk management, change control, and closure.
  • Facilitate meetings and workshops to gather requirements, document outcomes, and maintain project artifacts, timelines, and tracking using tools such as MS Project and Jira.
  • Coordinate across engineering, NOC, IT, procurement, vendors, and leadership to align technical requirements, dependencies, and operational workflows.
  • Collaborate with technology, automation, DevOps, and IT teams to ensure timely delivery and seamless integration of platforms, tools, and features.
  • Translate network architecture and engineering requirements into actionable project plans and execution strategies.
  • Drive implementation and integration of NMS/EMS and OSS/BSS platforms, as well as monitoring, telemetry, and performance management solutions.
  • Oversee development and deployment of NOC tools, dashboards, automation scripts, and API-based integrations to support fault management and operational efficiency.
  • Lead disaster recovery planning, testing, documentation, and escalation procedures for critical network and system components.
  • Coordinate sparing and high-availability strategies with engineering and supply chain teams to enable rapid fault recovery.
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities across provisioning, monitoring, and incident response to improve scalability and reduce MTTR.
  • Champion continuous improvement initiatives focused on operational efficiency, reliability, and adoption of advanced analytics and AI-driven operations.
  • Provide regular status updates and executive-level reporting, and perform other duties as assigned.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS:

  • High school diploma or GED required; bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or related field and/or PMP certification preferred.
  • Strong understanding of IP networking (BGP, OSPF, MPLS, QoS) and transport technologies (DWDM, Ethernet, SDH/SONET).
  • Experience with OSS/NMS/EMS platforms, network monitoring tools, and ticketing systems.
  • Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, and MS Project.
  • Familiarity with NOC operations, incident management, and change control processes.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across teams.
  • Strategic, analytical, and problem-solving mindset with a strong technical foundation.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously and drive results through cross-functional collaboration.

ADDITIONAL JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • 2+ years of project management experience in an IT, telecommunications, or service provider environment.
  • PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, or Scrum certification preferred.
  • Experience with network automation and infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, Itential, Python) preferred.
  • Networking certifications and/or hands-on experience (e.g., Cisco or Juniper) preferred.
  • Ability to support after-hours and weekend work as required.
  • Position is remote or hybrid/on-site (Evansville, IN), with periodic travel to Evansville, IN (approximately twice per year).

Metronet is an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity, race, gender, religion, age, national origin, color, disability, or veteran status. EOE/Minority/Female/Disabled/Veteran

raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana, a Fortune 100 Company, is looking for an experienced and Certified Inpatient Medical Coding Auditor to review inpatient hospital claims for proper reimbursement and resolve provider disputes. Your expertise will directly contribute to overall cost reduction, by increasing the accuracy of provider contract payments in our payer systems, ensuring correct claims payment and appropriate diagnosis related group assignments.

The Certified Inpatient Medical Coding Auditor extracts clinical information from a variety of medical records and assigns appropriate procedural terminology and medical codes (e.g., ICD-10-CM, CPT) to patient records.

The goal is to ensure the accuracy and integrity of hospital claim payments. Responsibilities include the following:

  • Review inpatient medical records and claims to ensure accurate coding and reimbursement
  • Assign and validate ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, and DRG codes
  • Audit coding quality and identify opportunities for improvement
  • Investigate and resolve provider disputes with a fair, fact-based approach
  • Analyze complex clinical documentation and coding scenarios
  • Collaborate with other teams to clarify coding and medical information
  • Contribute to cost savings by improving payment accuracy and reducing errors


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of MSDRG coding auditing experience
  • RHIA, RHIT or CCS Certification (must have held certification for at least 4 years)
  • Experience performing inpatient coding audits in a health insurance or hospital setting
  • Experience reading and interpreting claims
  • Proficiency in gathering or referencing data within different systems simultaneously

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in APDRG coding/auditing
  • Experience in Financial Recovery
  • Experience in a metric driven operational setting

Additional Information

WORK HOURS are Monday-Friday, 8 hours per day, 40 hours per week, and are scheduled between 6AM-6PM. Potential shift to be discussed during the interview.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

40

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.Application Deadline: 09-04-2026

Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.
